p5.s: Please submit your travel expense report to the accounting department ___ after returning from your business trip.
p5.ex: 空格修飾介系詞片語 after returning...，需用副詞 immediately（立即）。immediate 是形容詞，不能修飾介系詞片語或動詞。

p5.s: The marketing team presented a ___ analysis of customer feedback collected during the spring promotion.
p5.ex: 冠詞 a 與名詞 analysis 之間需要形容詞，故選 comprehensive（全面的）。comprehensively 是副詞，不能修飾名詞。

p5.s: Ms. Okafor's ___ to the expansion project has earned her a nomination for the employee excellence award.
p5.ex: 所有格 Ms. Okafor's 後面需接名詞作主詞，且動詞 has earned 為單數，故選 contribution。contributed 是動詞過去式／過去分詞，不能放在所有格後當主詞。

p5.s: Because Mr. Lindqvist submitted the permit application in a ___ manner, the renovation of Suite 410 began on schedule.
p5.ex: a ___ manner 中間需形容詞，timely 雖以 -ly 結尾卻是形容詞（及時的），為 990 級陷阱。timelessly 是副詞，不能修飾名詞 manner；timeliness 是名詞。

p5.s: Each of the new employees ___ required to complete a safety training session by Friday.
p5.ex: Each of + 複數名詞，真正主詞是 Each，視為單數，故用 is。are 是被 employees 誤導的選項。

p5.s: The list of approved vendors ___ updated every quarter by the purchasing department.
p5.ex: 主詞是 The list（單數），of approved vendors 只是修飾語，故用 is。are 與 have been 都是被 vendors 誤導的複數動詞。

p5.s: Neither the manager nor the assistants ___ aware of the change in the delivery schedule until this morning.
p5.ex: Neither A nor B 的動詞與靠近的 B（the assistants，複數）一致，且 until this morning 指過去，故用 were。was 雖是過去式，但與複數主詞不一致。

p5.s: A number of applicants who applied for the regional sales position at Harborview Logistics last month ___ already been contacted for interviews.
p5.ex: A number of + 複數名詞（許多…）視為複數，故用 have been contacted。has 是陷阱：誤把 a number 或中間插入的單數名詞 position、month 當主詞；只有 the number of 才接單數動詞。

p5.s: All ___ must sign in at the front desk before entering the research laboratory on the fifth floor.
p5.ex: All 後需接可當主詞的複數名詞，指「人」，故選 visitors。visit 雖可作名詞，但「所有參觀行為必須簽到」語意不通且須為複數。

p5.s: Diego Alvarez received ___ from the board to hire two additional engineers for the Lisbon office.
p5.ex: 動詞 received 後需名詞作受詞，故選 approval（核准）。approved 是動詞過去式／分詞，不能當受詞。

p5.s: The conference organizers are looking for ___ experienced interpreter who can translate between Japanese and Portuguese.
p5.ex: 單數可數名詞 interpreter 前需冠詞，且 experienced 以母音發音開頭，故用 an。a 不能用在母音開頭字前；much 接不可數、few 接複數名詞。

p5.s: After the annual inspection revealed several worn-out items, the warehouse manager ordered new safety ___ for all employees.
p5.ex: equipment（設備）是不可數名詞，沒有複數形，故選 equipment。equipments 是常見陷阱，看到 several items 就誤以為要用複數。

p5.s: Ms. Raman asked ___ assistant to reserve a conference room for Thursday afternoon.
p5.ex: 名詞 assistant 前需所有格，故選 her。hers 是所有格代名詞，本身即可當名詞，後面不能再接名詞。

p5.s: Rather than sending it to the legal department, Mr. Becker reviewed the contract ___ to save time.
p5.ex: 句子已有主詞與受詞，空格表「親自」強調主詞，需反身代名詞 himself。him 是受格，放在 the contract 後沒有語法功能。

p5.s: According to a recent market survey, our delivery fees are lower than ___ of our major competitors.
p5.ex: 比較對象是複數名詞 delivery fees，代替時需用 those（= the delivery fees）。that 只能代替單數或不可數名詞，是最常見的陷阱。

p5.s: Since her promotion last year, Hana Sato has managed several key client accounts on her ___, without help from the regional office.
p5.ex: on one's own 是固定用法，表「獨自、靠自己」，故選 own。self 不能接在 on her 後；oneself 是泛指反身代名詞，不能接在所有格 her 之後。

p5.s: The new office chairs are very ___ and have received positive feedback from the staff.
p5.ex: be 動詞 are 與副詞 very 之後需形容詞當主詞補語，故選 comfortable。comfortably 是副詞，不能當補語。

p5.s: Customers who sign up for the membership program will receive ___ discounts on all seasonal merchandise.
p5.ex: 名詞 discounts 前需形容詞修飾，故選 additional（額外的）。additionally 是副詞，不能修飾名詞。

p5.s: Several highly ___ candidates were interviewed for the position of finance director last week.
p5.ex: 副詞 highly 與名詞 candidates 之間需形容詞，qualified 表「有資格的、合格的」。qualification 是名詞，不能被 highly 修飾並放在名詞前。

p5.s: Due to rising material costs, the renovation of the Westbrook Hotel lobby required a ___ amount of additional funding.
p5.ex: considerable 表「相當大的」，修飾 amount 語意正確。considerate 意為「體貼的」，只用來形容人或行為，是同字根易混淆陷阱。

p5.s: The technician ___ repaired the printer on the third floor before the morning meeting began.
p5.ex: 主詞與動詞 repaired 之間需副詞修飾動詞，故選 quickly。quick 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞。

p5.s: Sales of the new smartwatch have increased ___ since the advertising campaign was launched in March.
p5.ex: 不及物動詞 increased 後需副詞修飾，故選 significantly（大幅地）。significant 是形容詞，無法修飾動詞。

p5.s: The revised budget proposal was ___ approved by all members of the finance committee on Monday.
p5.ex: be 動詞與過去分詞 approved 之間需副詞，故選 unanimously（全體一致地）。unanimous 是形容詞，不能修飾分詞。

p5.s: Ms. Lindqvist's proposal for reducing shipping costs was ___ praised by the investors at Monday's meeting.
p5.ex: highly 表「高度地、非常」，用來修飾 praised 這類抽象評價（highly praised 受到高度讚揚）。high 雖也可當副詞，但多指具體的高度或位置（如 fly high、rank high），不用來修飾 praised，是 990 級陷阱。

p5.s: The quarterly sales meeting will be held ___ Tuesday, April 14, in Conference Room B.
p5.ex: 星期與特定日期前用介系詞 on。in 用於月份、年份，at 用於時刻。

p5.s: All online orders placed ___ 3 P.M. will be shipped on the same business day.
p5.ex: 「下午三點前下的訂單」用 before 表時間點之前。during 後需接一段期間而非時刻；since 需搭配完成式。

p5.s: The Harlow City Museum will remain open to the public ___ the renovation of its east wing.
p5.ex: 空格後是名詞片語 the renovation，需介系詞 during（在…期間）。while 是連接詞，後面須接子句。

p5.s: ___ recent feedback from corporate clients, Morrow Consulting has decided to extend its office hours on weekdays.
p5.ex: In light of 表「鑒於、考量到」，說明延長營業時間的原因，語意最合理。Regardless of（不論）與「因回饋而決定」的因果關係矛盾；As though 是連接詞，不能接名詞片語。

p5.s: The shipment to our Denver warehouse was delayed ___ the delivery truck broke down on the highway.
p5.ex: 空格後是完整子句，且表原因，需連接詞 because。because of 是介系詞片語，後面只能接名詞。

p5.s: ___ the Bayview Hotel is located far from downtown, it remains popular with business travelers.
p5.ex: 前後語意相反（位置偏遠卻仍受歡迎），且後接子句，需讓步連接詞 Although。Despite 是介系詞，不能接子句。

p5.s: Employees may work from home on Fridays ___ they inform their supervisors at least one day in advance.
p5.ex: as long as 表「只要」，引導條件子句，語意與結構皆正確。in spite of 與 according to 是介系詞，不能接子句。

p5.s: Ms. Sato will approve the budget increase ___ the department can show measurable results by the end of the third quarter.
p5.ex: provided that 為連接詞，表「只要、前提是」，引導條件子句。in the event of 與 regardless of 是介系詞片語，不能接子句；whereas 表對比，語意不符。

p5.s: The shuttle bus to the airport ___ every thirty minutes from the main entrance of the hotel.
p5.ex: every thirty minutes 表固定時刻表或習慣，用現在簡單式，主詞 bus 為單數，故選 leaves。leave 與單數主詞不一致。

p5.s: Mr. Alvarez cannot take your call right now because he ___ with a client in the conference room.
p5.ex: right now 表說話當下正在進行的動作，用現在進行式 is meeting。meets 表習慣，不符合「此刻正在開會」。

p5.s: Currently, the IT department ___ a new security system to better protect customer data.
p5.ex: Currently 表目前正在進行，用現在進行式 is installing。installed 是過去式，與 Currently 不符。

p5.s: The renovated apartment on Elm Street ___ to a retired couple who moved in last spring.
p5.ex: belong（屬於）是狀態動詞，不用進行式，主詞 apartment 為單數，故用 belongs。is belonging 是陷阱：狀態動詞即使描述現況也不能用進行式。

p5.s: Ms. Okafor ___ the company's Seoul branch last year to meet with potential investors.
p5.ex: last year 是明確的過去時間，用過去簡單式 visited。has visited 現在完成式不能與明確過去時間連用。

p5.s: Pinecrest Bank ___ more than 200 new customers since it opened its downtown branch in January.
p5.ex: since + 過去時間點，主要子句用現在完成式 has attracted 表從過去持續到現在。attracted 是過去式，不能搭配 since 子句表延續到現在。

p5.s: The board of directors ___ the merger proposal two weeks ago after a lengthy discussion.
p5.ex: two weeks ago 表過去特定時間，用過去簡單式 approved。has approved 不能與 ago 連用。

p5.s: It has been three years since Tom Becker ___ the marketing team at Kesterly Partners as its director.
p5.ex: It has been + 時間 + since 子句時，since 子句描述過去某時點發生的事，用過去簡單式 joined。has joined 是陷阱：現在完成式應放在主要子句，而非 since 子句。

p5.s: Mr. Sato ___ a presentation to the sales team when the fire alarm suddenly went off.
p5.ex: when 子句是過去發生的短暫動作，打斷正在進行的動作，故用過去進行式 was giving。has given 是現在完成式，與過去事件時間不符。

p5.s: By the time the clients arrived for the banquet, the catering staff ___ all the tables in the main hall.
p5.ex: By the time + 過去式（arrived），表在過去某時點之前已完成，用過去完成式 had set。has set 是現在完成式，無法對應過去時間點。

p5.s: While the engineers ___ the new accounting software, they discovered several security flaws.
p5.ex: While 子句表過去某段期間正在進行的動作，主要子句 discovered 為過去式，故用過去進行式 were testing。have tested 與過去時態不一致。

p5.s: Priya Raman ___ for Fairmont Electronics for six years before she joined Kesterly Partners in 2023.
p5.ex: 「加入新公司（2023 年，過去）之前」已持續工作六年，屬於「過去的過去」，用過去完成式 had worked。has worked 是陷阱：for six years 讓人想用現在完成式，但時間基準點是過去的 2023 年。

p5.s: Last week, the store manager ___ a new work schedule for weekend staff.
p5.ex: Last week 表過去時間，用過去簡單式 announced。announces 是現在式，與時間副詞不符。

p5.s: Greenfield Publishing ___ its annual report every April since it was founded in 1998.
p5.ex: since + 過去時間點（創立於 1998 年）表從過去持續到現在，主要子句用現在完成式 has published。publishes 雖能表習慣，但不能與 since 連用。

p5.s: When Ms. Okafor finally arrived at the airport, her flight to Frankfurt ___ already departed.
p5.ex: 抵達機場（過去）之前飛機已起飛，屬於「過去的過去」，用過去完成式 had departed。has departed 是現在完成式，無法對應過去事件 arrived；will 後須接原形動詞，having 則使句子缺少主要動詞。

p5.s: By the time the new headquarters opens next spring, the company ___ in its current building for over twenty years.
p5.ex: By the time + 現在式（opens next spring）表未來時間點，主要子句用未來完成式 will have operated。had operated 是陷阱：By the time 常搭配過去完成式，但此處 opens 與 next spring 指向未來。

p5.s: The new branch office of Lakeside Insurance ___ next month in downtown Toronto.
p5.ex: next month 表未來時間，用 will open。opened 與 has opened 都是過去或完成時態，與未來時間不符。

p5.s: Please contact the front desk as soon as the furniture delivery from Brightline ___ at the loading dock.
p5.ex: as soon as 引導時間副詞子句，以現在式代替未來式，故用 arrives。will arrive 是常見陷阱：時間子句中不使用 will。

p5.s: Harlow Cosmetics' new skincare line is ___ to launch in European markets early next year.
p5.ex: be set to + 原形動詞是「預定要…」的未來表達，故選 set。setting 會變成主動進行式，語意不通。

p5.s: Once the renovation of the second floor ___, the human resources department will move into Suite 210.
p5.ex: Once 引導時間子句，以現在式代替未來式；renovation 是「被完成」，需被動語態 is completed。will be completed 是陷阱：時間子句中不可用 will。

p5.s: Employees who wish to attend the leadership seminar should ___ their supervisor by Friday afternoon.
p5.ex: 助動詞 should 後面一律接原形動詞，故選 notify。to notify 雖是不定詞，但助動詞後不可加 to。

p5.s: Applicants ___ submit a portfolio, but doing so may strengthen their application considerably.
p5.ex: 後句說「提交作品集可加分」，表示「不必」提交，need not 為助動詞用法（後接原形）。must not／cannot 表禁止，與後句矛盾；ought 須接 to。

p5.s: Before the merger, Brightline Furniture ___ manufacture all of its products at a single plant in Ohio.
p5.ex: used to + 原形動詞表示「過去曾經（現在已不再）」，符合 Before the merger。be used to 後接 V-ing／名詞，表「習慣於」，此處後接原形 manufacture，故錯。

p5.s: It is imperative that every contractor ___ a valid safety certification before entering the construction site.
p5.ex: It is imperative that 後的子句須用（should +）原形動詞，故選 hold。主詞為單數 contractor，容易誤選 holds，但此句型不隨主詞變化。

p5.s: The annual sales report ___ by the finance team every December.
p5.ex: 報告是「被」準備，且後有 by the finance team，須用被動 is prepared。prepared 單獨使用會使句子缺少動詞（或成為主動「報告準備了…」）。

p5.s: Since the policy was revised in March, all expense claims ___ through the new online portal.
p5.ex: Since + 過去時間點搭配現在完成式，而費用申請是「被處理」，故用被動 have been processed。have processed 是主動，主詞 claims 無法自己處理。

p5.s: The proposal from Kessler Engineering ___ carefully before the board votes on it next Monday.
p5.ex: 提案是「被審閱」，且時間在下週一之前（未來），故用未來被動 will be reviewed。will review 為主動，後面又缺受詞。

p5.s: Several technical problems ___ during the installation of the new inventory system last week.
p5.ex: occur 為不及物動詞，沒有被動語態，且 last week 用過去式，故選 occurred。were occurred 是常見陷阱，「問題被發生」不合文法。

p5.s: The manager made the new interns ___ the safety training video before they began work on the factory floor.
p5.ex: 使役動詞 make + 受詞 + 原形動詞，故選 watch。to watch 只有在被動 be made to V 時才使用。

p5.s: After several phone calls, we finally got the supplier ___ the defective parts free of charge.
p5.ex: get + 人 + to V 表「說服／促使某人做」，故選 to replace。get 雖有使役意味，但不同於 make／have，不接原形 replace。

p5.s: The security guard noticed a man ___ the building through the rear entrance late last night.
p5.ex: 感官動詞 notice + 受詞 + 原形動詞（或 V-ing），選項中只有 enter 符合。感官動詞後不接 to V。

p5.s: Before the trade fair, Ms. Raman had the product brochures ___ into Spanish and Portuguese by a professional agency.
p5.ex: have + 物 + 過去分詞表示「請人把某物處理好」，手冊是「被翻譯」，且後有 by a professional agency，故選 translated。translate 用於 have + 人 + 原形。

p5.s: The receptionist handed the visitor badges ___ the guests as they arrived for the facility tour.
p5.ex: hand 為授予動詞，「hand + 物 + to + 人」，故選 to。for 用於 buy、make 等「為某人做」的動詞。

p5.s: Mr. Alvarez bought a farewell gift ___ his retiring colleague on behalf of the entire accounting department.
p5.ex: buy 屬於「buy + 物 + for + 人」的授予動詞，故選 for。to 用於 give、send、hand 等動詞，此處誤用。

p5.s: Each new employee ___ a laptop and a building access card on the first day of work.
p5.ex: 授予動詞 give 以「人」為主詞的被動：人 + be given + 物。新員工是「被給予」筆電，故選 is given；gives 為主動，意思變成員工給出筆電。

p5.s: Dr. Hana Sato ___ the Lindgren Prize for her research on sustainable packaging at last night's ceremony.
p5.ex: award 的被動：人 + be awarded + 獎項，Dr. Sato 是「獲頒」獎項，且時間為 last night，故選 was awarded。awarded 雖後接名詞看似合法，但主動語意變成她「頒發」獎項，與 for her research 不合。

p5.s: Customers report that the new office chairs feel very ___ even after several hours of use.
p5.ex: feel 作連綴動詞時後接形容詞補語，故選 comfortable。comfortably 是副詞，不能當補語。

p5.s: Despite the economic slowdown, consumer demand for electric bicycles has remained ___ throughout the year.
p5.ex: remain 為連綴動詞，後接形容詞說明主詞狀態，故選 strong。strongly 為副詞，無法作主詞補語。

p5.s: The terms of the revised agreement seem ___ to both parties, so the contract will likely be signed this week.
p5.ex: seem 為連綴動詞，後接形容詞，故選 acceptable（可接受的）。acceptance 是名詞，「條款似乎是接受」語意不通。

p5.s: Although material costs rose sharply, the company's quarterly profits held ___ throughout the fiscal year.
p5.ex: hold 在此作連綴動詞（hold steady＝保持穩定），後接形容詞 steady。steadily 為副詞，是最常見的陷阱，但連綴動詞後須接形容詞補語。

p5.s: Mr. Lindqvist decided ___ the budget meeting until all the regional sales figures were available.
p5.ex: decide 後接不定詞 to V，故選 to postpone。decide 不接動名詞 postponing。

p5.s: The marketing director suggested ___ the product launch to coincide with the holiday shopping season.
p5.ex: suggest 後接動名詞 V-ing 作受詞，故選 moving。suggest 不接 to V，to move 為常見陷阱。

p5.s: Ms. Raman is looking forward to ___ with the design team in Milan next month.
p5.ex: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後接動名詞，故選 working。容易誤以為 to 是不定詞而選 work。

p5.s: Harlow Logistics is committed to ___ its carbon emissions by 30 percent over the next five years.
p5.ex: be committed to（致力於）的 to 為介系詞，後接動名詞，故選 reducing。reduce 是把 to 誤當不定詞的陷阱。

p5.s: The new laser printer is ___ than the old model and uses considerably less ink.
p5.ex: 後有 than，須用比較級；fast 的比較級為 faster，故選 faster。more fast 錯誤，單音節形容詞加 -er。

p5.s: Of all the applicants interviewed, Ms. Okafor had the ___ experience in international marketing.
p5.ex: Of all the applicants 表示三者以上的比較，須用最高級 the most。the more 用於「the + 比較級, the + 比較級」或兩者比較，此處不合。

p5.s: This year's technology conference attracted twice as many participants ___ last year's event.
p5.ex: 倍數比較句型為「twice as + 原級 + as」，故選 as。前面已有 as many，不可用 than。

p5.s: The earlier you register for the workshop, the ___ the discount you will receive.
p5.ex: 「the + 比較級..., the + 比較級...」表「越…越…」，故選 larger。largest 為最高級，不能用於此句型；more largely 為副詞，無法修飾 discount。

p5.s: It was Mr. Becker ___ suggested holding the company picnic at Riverside Park this year.
p5.ex: 強調句 It was + 人 + who + 動詞，被強調的是人且作主詞，故選 who。whom 為受格，後面不能直接接動詞。

p5.s: Never before ___ the company received so many positive reviews as it has this year.
p5.ex: 否定副詞 Never before 置首須倒裝，後有過去分詞 received 及 as it has this year，故用現在完成式 has。did 後須接原形動詞，不能接 received。

p5.s: Not only ___ the new model lighter than its predecessor, but it is also more energy-efficient.
p5.ex: Not only 置首須倒裝，lighter 為形容詞，須搭配 be 動詞，故選 is。does 後須接原形動詞；it is 未倒裝。

p5.s: Only after the safety inspection was completed ___ the workers allowed to reenter the factory floor.
p5.ex: Only after 子句置首時，主要子句須倒裝；workers 為複數且為「被允許」（be allowed to），故選 were。was 單複數不一致；did 後須接原形動詞。

p5.s: If the shipment arrives on time, we ___ the new window display before the store opens on Monday.
p5.ex: If 子句為現在式 arrives，表示未來可能發生的條件，主要子句用 will + 原形，故選 will set up。would set up 用於與現在事實相反的假設。

p5.s: If our team had received the survey data earlier, we ___ the report by the original deadline.
p5.ex: If 子句為 had + p.p.，是與過去事實相反的假設，主要子句用 would have + p.p.，故選 would have completed。would complete 是與現在事實相反，時間不符。

p5.s: If Ms. Alvarez ___ more time, she would review every job application personally.
p5.ex: 主要子句為 would + 原形，表示與現在事實相反的假設，If 子句須用過去式，故選 had。has 屬於可能發生的條件句，與 would 不搭配。

p5.s: ___ the board approved the budget increase, the renovation project would have started in March.
p5.ex: 主要子句為 would have + p.p.，與過去事實相反；省略 if 的倒裝為 Had + 主詞 + p.p.，故選 Had。If 後須接 had approved，不能接 approved；Were 後不接過去式動詞。

p5.s: Ms. Becker asked the receptionist ___ the conference room had been cleaned before the client meeting.
p5.ex: ask + 人 + if／whether 子句，表示「詢問是否」，故選 if。ask 不接 that 子句表示詢問；what 後須接不完整子句。

p5.s: The results of the customer survey show ___ most respondents prefer to receive product updates by e-mail.
p5.ex: show 後接名詞子句作受詞，後面子句完整（主詞 respondents＋動詞 prefer），故用 that。what 後須接缺少主詞或受詞的不完整子句。

p5.s: ___ impressed the judges most was the simplicity of the mobile application's design.
p5.ex: 空格引導名詞子句作主詞，且子句缺少主詞（___ impressed the judges），須用 what（＝the thing that）。That 引導的名詞子句必須是完整句。

p5.s: The planning committee has not reached a decision on ___ the annual retreat should be held in Denver or Seattle.
p5.ex: 介系詞 on 後接名詞子句，表「是否」只能用 whether，不能用 if。that 子句不能接在介系詞後；what 後須接不完整子句。

p5.s: The engineer ___ designed the new cooling system will present it at Tuesday's department meeting.
p5.ex: 先行詞 engineer 是人，且關係子句缺主詞，故用主格 who。whom 是受格，不能作子句主詞。

p5.s: Customers ___ orders exceed $200 qualify for free express shipping on all domestic deliveries.
p5.ex: 空格後接名詞 orders，表示「顧客的訂單」，須用所有格關係代名詞 whose。who 後須接缺主詞的子句，但此處 orders 已是主詞。

p5.s: The assembly manual includes several diagrams, most of ___ show how to attach the shelves safely.
p5.ex: 介系詞 of 後的關係代名詞須用 which（指 diagrams），most of which 引導子句。them 會造成兩個子句缺連接詞；that 不可接在介系詞後。

p5.s: The software upgrade, ___ which our technicians had been preparing for months, was completed over the weekend.
p5.ex: 關係子句還原為 our technicians had been preparing for the upgrade（prepare for 準備…），介系詞移到 which 前，故選 for。with／in／to 均無法與 prepare 構成「為…做準備」。

p5.s: The hotel ___ the regional sales conference will be held is located just ten minutes from the airport.
p5.ex: 先行詞 hotel 為地點，且後面子句完整（被動句 conference will be held），須用關係副詞 where。which 後須接缺主詞或受詞的子句。

p5.s: Please make a note of the date ___ the new parking regulations take effect at the Elmwood campus.
p5.ex: 先行詞 date 表時間，後面子句完整（regulations take effect），故用關係副詞 when。which 後須接不完整子句。

p5.s: Nobody in the shipping department could explain the reason ___ the order was delayed for three weeks.
p5.ex: 先行詞為 the reason，後接完整子句，須用關係副詞 why。which 後須接不完整子句；what 本身已含先行詞，不能接在名詞後。

p5.s: The office building ___ the company purchased last spring will be fully renovated next year.
p5.ex: 先行詞雖為地點 building，但關係子句缺少 purchased 的受詞，須用關係代名詞 which。where 後須接完整子句，是最常見的陷阱。

p5.s: After ___ the customer's e-mail, Ms. Sato immediately called the client to confirm the order details.
p5.ex: After 在此為介系詞（分詞構句保留連接詞），後接動名詞／現在分詞 reading。read、reads、to read 均不能接在介系詞後。

p5.s: ___ in 1985, Delmont Bakery has grown into a chain of 40 stores across the region.
p5.ex: 主詞 Delmont Bakery 是「被創立」的，分詞構句用過去分詞 Founded（＝Having been founded）。Founding／Having founded 為主動，語意變成麵包店去創立別人。

p5.s: ___ by the strong first-quarter sales figures, the board approved a second production line.
p5.ex: 董事會是「受到」亮眼銷售數字「鼓舞」，且後有 by，故用過去分詞 Encouraged。Encouraging 為主動，表示董事會去鼓勵別人，語意不符。

p5.s: Unless otherwise ___, all prices listed in our online catalog include applicable sales tax.
p5.ex: Unless otherwise specified 是 Unless (they are) otherwise specified 的省略，價格是「被註明」，故用過去分詞 specified。specifying 為主動，與被動語意不符。

p5.s: Ms. Okafor asked all new employees to ___ the attached form and return it to Human Resources by Friday.
p5.ex: complete the form 表示「填寫完成表格」，與後面 return it 相呼應。attend 是「出席」，decide「決定」，remind「提醒（某人）」，都不能搭配 form。

p5.s: The hotel shuttle ___ guests to the airport every thirty minutes from 6 A.M. to 11 P.M.
p5.ex: 空格後有受詞 guests，需要及物動詞；transport A to B 表「把 A 載送到 B」。arrives、travels、departs 皆為不及物動詞，後面不能直接接受詞。

p5.s: Customers who are not satisfied with their purchase may request a full ___ within 30 days.
p5.ex: 對購買不滿意可申請 a full refund「全額退款」。salary「薪水」、profit「利潤」、invoice「發票、請款單」都與退貨情境不合。

p5.s: Due to heavy snow, the outdoor concert has been ___ until next Saturday.
p5.ex: 因大雪而將音樂會「延期」到下週六，postpone ... until 為固定用法。extended 是「延長（期限、時間）」，不是改期；reserved「預訂」、prevented「阻止」語意不通。

p5.s: Please make a ___ at least two days in advance if you plan to dine with a large group.
p5.ex: make a reservation「訂位」是固定搭配，且與 dine with a large group 呼應。make a decision/suggestion 雖是常見搭配，但與「提前兩天、多人用餐」的情境不符。

p5.s: The new printer is much faster and uses less ink, so it will help us ___ money.
p5.ex: 使用較少墨水可以「省錢」，save money。lend「借出」、borrow「借入」、owe「欠」都與省墨水的因果關係無關。

p5.s: Visitors must show a valid photo ___ at the security desk before entering the building.
p5.ex: photo identification 指「附照片的身分證件」，進入大樓前出示，最符合情境。description「描述」、information「資訊」、application「申請」都不是可出示的證件。

p5.s: Ms. Sato was ___ to regional manager after five years of excellent work in the Tokyo office.
p5.ex: be promoted to + 職位「被升遷為…」，與 excellent work 呼應。applied 須用 apply for，retired「退休」、admitted「被允許進入」都不接職位。

p5.s: The package should ___ at your office no later than Thursday afternoon.
p5.ex: arrive at + 地點「抵達」。reach 與 approach 是及物動詞，不需介系詞 at；deliver 主詞應為送貨者，包裹本身不能 deliver。

p5.s: Because of the high ___ for the new tablet, many stores have already sold out.
p5.ex: high demand for「對…需求高」導致賣光，因果合理。supply 高不會造成缺貨；high price 也不會使商品搶購一空；amount 不與 for 搭配表示需求。

p5.s: The museum is ___ to the public from 9 A.M. to 5 P.M., Tuesday through Sunday.
p5.ex: be open to the public「對大眾開放」，後接開放時間。equal to「等於」、similar to「類似於」、polite to「對…有禮貌」皆不符語意。

p5.s: Please ___ the customer service team if you have any questions about your order.
p5.ex: contact 是及物動詞，可直接接受詞 the customer service team。speak 需 speak to/with，reply 與 respond 需加 to，都不能直接接受詞。

p5.s: The company ___ a 10 percent discount to employees who purchase its products.
p5.ex: offer a discount to 某人「提供折扣給…」。pays「支付」、spends「花費」、takes「拿取」都不能表示公司給員工折扣。

p5.s: Our team worked overtime to meet the ___ for the project proposal.
p5.ex: meet the deadline「趕上截止期限」是固定搭配，與 worked overtime 呼應。period、calendar、moment 都不與 meet 搭配表達「趕上」。

p5.s: Mr. Alvarez has more than ten years of ___ in hotel management.
p5.ex: years of experience in「在…領域的多年經驗」。experiment「實驗」、expectation「期待」、expense「費用」是字形相近的干擾選項。

p5.s: Applicants must ___ a minimum of three years of experience in software development.
p5.ex: possess experience「具備經驗」，主詞為人。consist 與 belong 是不及物動詞（須接 of/to）；contain「包含」主詞通常為物，不用於人具備經驗。

p5.s: The new safety regulations will take ___ on January 1, so all staff must complete training by then.
p5.ex: 法規「生效」為 take effect。take place 指活動「舉行」，不用於法規；take part「參加」、take action「採取行動」主詞須為人。

p5.s: Audience members are kindly asked to ___ from using mobile phones during the keynote presentation.
p5.ex: refrain from + V-ing「克制不做…」是常考搭配。avoid 與 stop 直接接 V-ing，不加 from；prevent 須用 prevent 某人 from V-ing，缺受詞。

p5.s: Sales of the compact model have ___ expectations, prompting the company to increase production.
p5.ex: exceed expectations「超出預期」，所以公司增產。overcome「克服（困難）」、outnumbered「在數量上超過」不與 expectations 搭配；excel 多為不及物（excel in）。

p5.s: The board will make a final ___ on the merger after reviewing the auditors' report.
p5.ex: make a decision on「對…做出決定」是固定搭配。opinion 常與 form/express 搭配；attention 與 pay 搭配；approach 不與 make 連用。

p5.s: Ms. Lindqvist is ___ for coordinating all travel arrangements for the sales team.
p5.ex: be responsible for V-ing「負責…」。capable 須接 of，aware 須接 of；eligible for 是「有資格獲得」，接 V-ing 表負責工作不合語意。

p5.s: To ___ a wider audience, the bakery has begun selling its products online.
p5.ex: reach a wider audience「接觸到更廣大的客群」為常見說法。arrive 與 proceed 是不及物動詞；extend「延伸」不與 audience 搭配。

p5.s: Free parking is available to guests on a first-come, first-___ basis.
p5.ex: on a first-come, first-served basis「先到先得」為固定用語，其他選項都不構成慣用語。

p5.s: The firm's quarterly earnings were ___ affected by rising fuel costs.
p5.ex: 燃料成本上升對獲利造成負面影響，adversely affected「受到不利影響」為常見搭配。considerately「體貼地」、reluctantly「不情願地」形容人；formerly「以前」不合語意。

p5.s: Employees who wish to work from home must first obtain ___ from their supervisor.
p5.ex: obtain permission from「取得…的許可」。admission「入場許可、入學」、submission「提交」、commission「佣金、委託」皆為字尾相同的干擾字。

p5.s: The conference room is fully ___ with a projector, speakers, and video-conferencing equipment.
p5.ex: be fully equipped with「配備齊全」。installed 的主詞應是設備本身（設備被安裝），不能說房間 installed with；attached、located 也不接 with + 設備清單。

p5.s: Due to a scheduling ___, the interview has been moved to Wednesday morning.
p5.ex: scheduling conflict「時間衝突、行程撞期」是固定搭配，因此面試改期。argument 與 dispute 指「爭吵、爭議」；contrast「對比」都不符。

p5.s: The warranty does not ___ damage caused by improper use or unauthorized repairs.
p5.ex: 保固「涵蓋」某範圍用 cover。hold「握著、舉辦」、carry「攜帶」、fill「填滿」都不能表示保固範圍。

p5.s: Ms. Raman ___ her colleagues that the client meeting had been rescheduled.
p5.ex: remind + 人 + that 子句「提醒某人…」。said、explained、announced 後面不能直接接「人」再接 that 子句（須用 to + 人）。

p5.s: The marketing team will ___ a survey to gather feedback from recent customers.
p5.ex: conduct a survey「進行調查」是常考搭配。behave 為不及物；commit 多接 crime/error；attend「出席」不接 survey。

p5.s: Rent for the office space is ___ on the first business day of each month.
p5.ex: be due on + 日期「在…到期應付」。ready「準備好的」、prior「在先的」、urgent「緊急的」都不表示付款到期日。

p5.s: Thanks to favorable weather, the renovation was completed ahead of ___, two weeks earlier than planned.
p5.ex: ahead of schedule「比預定提前」是固定搭配，與 two weeks earlier than planned 呼應。agenda「議程」、calendar「行事曆」、routine「例行公事」不構成此片語。

p5.s: Customers can ___ their orders online using the tracking number provided in the confirmation e-mail.
p5.ex: track an order「追蹤訂單」，與 tracking number 呼應。lead、guide、escort 都是「引導、護送」，用於人而非訂單。

p5.s: Ms. Okafor's proposal received ___ support from the board members, so it was approved without delay.
p5.ex: unanimous support「一致支持」，所以順利通過。anonymous「匿名的」形近易混；numerous 與 various 修飾可數複數名詞，不修飾不可數的 support。

p5.s: Please keep your receipt as ___ of purchase in case you need to return the item.
p5.ex: proof of purchase「購買證明」是固定用語，收據即為購買證明。mark「記號」、trace「痕跡」、figure「數字」都不構成此搭配。

p5.s: We would appreciate it if you could ___ the shipment, as the client needs the parts by Monday.
p5.ex: 客戶週一前就要零件，因此請對方 expedite the shipment「加快出貨」。expire「到期」為不及物；exceed「超過」、exploit「剝削、利用」與 shipment 不合。

p5.s: All refunds will be processed in ___ with the terms outlined in our return policy.
p5.ex: in accordance with「依照、按照」是正式書信常見片語。attendance「出席」、abundance「豐富」、acceptance「接受」都不構成 in ___ with 的慣用語。

p5.s: The product launch is ___ scheduled for March 15, pending final approval from the legal department.
p5.ex: pending final approval 表示日期尚未確定，故用 tentatively scheduled「暫定於」。temporarily 是「暫時地（一段時間內）」，修飾 scheduled 不道地；其他兩字語意不合。

p5.s: All contractors are required to ___ to the safety guidelines while working on the construction site.
p5.ex: adhere to「遵守」，空格後有介系詞 to。comply 須接 with；observe 與 follow 是及物動詞，後面不加 to。

p5.s: The merger is expected to result in ___ savings for both companies over the next five years.
p5.ex: substantial savings「可觀的節省」。substantive 意為「實質性的（討論、議題）」，不修飾金額；subordinate「下級的」、subsidiary「附屬的」語意不合。

p5.s: Please reply at your earliest ___ so that we can finalize the seating arrangements.
p5.ex: at your earliest convenience「在您方便時儘早」是書信慣用語。comfort、pleasure、welfare 都無此搭配（at your pleasure 意為「隨您意」，不與 earliest 連用）。

p5.s: The CEO's speech ___ the importance of sustainability in the company's long-term strategy.
p5.ex: underscore the importance of「強調…的重要性」。underwent「經歷」、undertook「承擔」、underwrote「承保、贊助」都不與 importance 搭配。

p5.s: Mr. Lindqvist was asked to ___ the dispute between the two suppliers before it went to court.
p5.ex: mediate a dispute「調解糾紛」，與 before it went to court 呼應。meditate「冥想」、medicate「用藥」、mandate「強制規定」為形近干擾字。

p5.s: Our sales figures for the third quarter were ___ with analysts' projections.
p5.ex: be consistent with「與…一致」。constant「持續不變的」、consecutive「連續的」、considerate「體貼的」都不接 with 表示「符合」。

p5.s: Employees are ___ for reimbursement of travel expenses incurred while on company business.
p5.ex: be eligible for reimbursement「有資格申請費用核銷」。liable for 是「對…負有（賠償）責任」，主詞為員工時表示員工要付錢，與語意相反；legible「字跡清楚的」、applicable「適用的」主詞須為規定。

p5.s: As a gesture of goodwill, the supplier agreed to ___ the late delivery fee for this order.
p5.ex: waive a fee「免除費用」為常考搭配。exempt 須用 exempt 某人 from 某事；evade「逃避（稅）」帶負面意涵；resign「辭職」不合。

p5.s: Ms. Alvarez has been ___ with overseeing the integration of the two accounting systems.
p5.ex: be tasked with V-ing「被賦予…任務」。assigned 須用 be assigned to；appointed 與 designated 後接職位（as/to），都不接 with。

p5.s: The figures in this report are ___ and may change once the audit is complete.
p5.ex: may change once the audit is complete 表示數字是「初步的」preliminary。precise「精確的」與「可能變動」矛盾；proficient「精通的」修飾人；prestigious「有聲望的」不合。

p5.s: Ms. Sato will ___ the responsibilities of department head until a permanent replacement is found.
p5.ex: assume responsibilities「承擔職責」，與 until a permanent replacement is found 呼應。presume「假定」、consume「消耗」、subsume「納入」皆為形近干擾字。

p5.s: Due to ___ circumstances, tonight's performance has been canceled, and ticket holders will receive full refunds.
p5.ex: due to unforeseen circumstances「由於不可預見的狀況」是公告常用語。unattended「無人看管的」、unoccupied「空著的」、uninformed「不知情的」都不修飾 circumstances。

p6.title: Parking lot repairs
p6.head:
To: All employees
From: Marisol Duarte, Facilities Manager
Date: April 8
Subject: Parking lot repairs
p6.text:
Starting on Monday, April 15, the north parking lot will be closed for repaving. The work is expected to {{1}} about two weeks, depending on the weather. During the work, the lot's lighting will also be upgraded, and the faded lines will be repainted.

During this time, employees should park in the south lot or in the public garage on Fenwick Street. The company will cover the cost of garage parking. Simply show your employee ID card to the attendant when you {{2}} the garage. Please note that the south lot fills up quickly, so we recommend {{3}} early.

We understand that this change may cause some inconvenience. {{4}} Thank you for your patience and cooperation.

qs.ex: 「be expected to take + 時間」表示「預計花費多少時間」，主詞是事情 (the work) 時用 take。spend 的主詞須為人，不能說 the work spends two weeks。
表時間的副詞子句 when you ___ 須用現在式代替未來式，故選 leave。will leave 違反「時間子句不用 will」的規則。
recommend 後接動名詞 (recommend + V-ing)，故選 arriving。recommend to arrive 是常見錯誤用法。

o: Your new ID card will be mailed to you next week.
The garage on Fenwick Street was closed for repairs last month.
Please submit your monthly expense report by Friday.
If you have any questions about these arrangements, please contact me at extension 214.
qs.ex: 結尾道歉之後提供聯絡方式再致謝，是公告信的典型結構，且 these arrangements 指前文停車安排。其他選項（新識別證、車庫上月關閉、費用報告）與停車場施工通知內容無關。

p6.title: Fitness room renovation

qs.ex: 主詞 new treadmills and exercise bikes 是「被安裝」的對象，will be + p.p. 構成被動，故選 installed。installing 會變成器材自己在安裝，語意錯誤。

o: The flooring and lighting in the room will also be updated.
The new equipment was very popular with members last year.
Please register for the class by calling the front desk.
Thank you for renewing your membership last year.
qs.ex: 前句說明整修會換新器材，此句用 also 補充「地板與照明也會更新」，延續整修內容。The new equipment was popular last year 用過去式，但器材尚未安裝，時間不合。
逗號後的非限定關係子句修飾 the swimming pool and the basketball court（事物），且子句缺主詞，故用 which。where 為關係副詞，後面須接完整子句。
空格修飾動詞 will be applied，須用副詞 automatically；後文「so there is no need to contact the front desk」也呼應自動套用。automatic 為形容詞，不能修飾動詞。

p6.title: New expense reporting system
p6.head:
To: All Sales Staff
From: Kenji Mori, Accounting Manager
Date: September 12
Subject: New expense reporting system
p6.text:
Beginning October 1, all travel and business expenses must be submitted through ExpensePro, our new online reporting system. Paper forms will no longer be {{1}}.

ExpensePro allows you to take a photo of a receipt with your phone and upload it {{2}} seconds. The system then fills in the date and amount for you. {{3}} As a result, most reimbursements should be processed within five business days.

To help everyone get started, the accounting team will hold two training sessions next week. Each session will last about one hour. Please sign up for one of them by {{4}} Ms. Lucia Ferreira at extension 330. Attendance is strongly recommended for anyone who travels regularly for work.

qs.ex: 前句說所有費用必須透過新系統提交，因此紙本表格「不再被受理」，選 accepted。expired 是不及物動詞，不能用被動 be expired 表示此意。
within + 時間 表示「在…之內」，within seconds 即「幾秒內」。during 後接一段事件或期間（during the meeting），不接 seconds 這種數量概念。

o: Completed reports are then sent to your manager for approval immediately.
The training room is located on the third floor.
Paper forms were first introduced several years ago.
The sales team exceeded its targets this quarter.
qs.ex: 空格後「As a result, most reimbursements should be processed within five business days」需要一個造成「處理更快」的原因，報告立即送主管核准正好是原因。其他選項無法與 As a result 形成因果關係。
介系詞 by 後須接名詞或動名詞，by contacting 表示「藉由聯絡」。to contact 為不定詞，不能放在介系詞後。

p6.title: Brightline Furniture summer sale
p6.text:
{{1}} From July 5 to July 20, all sofas, dining tables, and office chairs at Brightline Furniture will be reduced {{2}} up to 40 percent. This is the perfect time to update your home or workspace. Shop our full range of styles, from classic to modern.

Customers who spend more than $500 will also receive free delivery anywhere within the city. Our experienced delivery team will also assemble your furniture at no extra charge. In addition, our design consultants are available to help you choose items that {{3}} your space and budget.

Visit our showroom at 210 Harbor Avenue, open daily from 10 A.M. to 8 P.M., or shop online at www.brightlinefurniture.com. Quantities are limited, {{4}} we encourage you to shop early.

o: Your order has been shipped and will arrive in three days.
The sale was extended because of bad weather.
Unfortunately, this item is no longer available.
Are you looking for high-quality furniture at affordable prices?
qs.ex: 廣告開頭常用問句吸引顧客，接著介紹特價活動「From July 5 to July 20…」。The sale was extended 不合理，因為特價活動尚未開始，談不上延長。
reduce by + 幅度 表示「降低多少」，reduced by up to 40 percent 即「最多降價 40%」。at 用於 at a discount / at 40 percent off，不與 reduced 搭配表示幅度。
fit your space and budget 表示「符合您的空間與預算」，fit 為及物動詞。agree、depend、belong 皆為不及物動詞，須加介系詞 (agree with / depend on / belong to)。
數量有限（原因）→ 所以建議早點購買（結果），用 so 表因果。but 和 although 表轉折，前後並無對比關係。

p6.title: Hotel reservation confirmation
p6.head:
Harborview Hotel
45 Bayside Drive
San Diego, CA 92101

May 2

Ms. Priya Raman
1880 Elm Street
Austin, TX 78701

Dear Ms. Raman,
p6.text:
Thank you for choosing the Harborview Hotel. This letter {{1}} your reservation for a deluxe room from June 10 to June 13. The total cost of your stay is $540, including taxes. {{2}}

Since you mentioned that you will be attending the Pacific Marketing Conference, you may be interested in our free shuttle service. Shuttles depart from the main entrance every 30 minutes {{3}} 7:00 A.M. and 9:00 P.M. The ride to the convention center takes about ten minutes.

If you need to change your plans, please call us at least 48 hours before your arrival date. Cancellations made after that time will be charged for one night. We look {{4}} to welcoming you.

Sincerely,
Daniel Ortiz
Guest Services Manager

qs.ex: 信件本身正在確認訂房，陳述現況用現在簡單式 confirms，且後有受詞 your reservation 須用主動。was confirmed / has been confirmed 為被動，後面不能再接受詞。

o: The conference has been canceled due to low registration.
We hope you enjoyed your stay with us.
Your room was cleaned this morning.
This amount will be charged to your credit card when you check in.
qs.ex: This amount 指前句「The total cost of your stay is $540」，說明付款方式，銜接自然。We hope you enjoyed your stay 為退房後用語，但房客尚未入住。
between A and B 表示「在 A 與 B 之間」，此處指早上 7 點到晚上 9 點之間。from 須搭配 to（from 7:00 A.M. to 9:00 P.M.），不能與 and 連用。
look forward to + V-ing 是固定搭配，意為「期待」。look after 是「照顧」，look up 是「查詢」，皆不合語意。

p6.title: Ordering groceries online

qs.ex: be 動詞 is 後接形容詞作補語，convenient for you 表示「對您方便」。convenience 為名詞，a delivery time that is convenience 不合文法。
費用是「被收取」的，主詞 a fee 須搭配被動語態 is charged。charges 為主動，會變成「費用去收費」，語意錯誤。
保冷袋讓冷凍食品保持低溫「直到」送達家門，用 until。unless 表「除非」，語意不通。

o: Our stores are open from 7 A.M. to 10 P.M. every day.
Fresh bread is baked in our stores every morning.
Our new store on Maple Road opened last spring.
If you do not want a substitution, simply note this when you place your order.
qs.ex: 前句說缺貨時會「replace it with a similar product」，此句說明若不想被替換該怎麼做，substitution 正呼應 replace。其他選項談門市營業時間或新店，與替換商品無關。

p6.title: Setting up your wireless printer
p6.text:
Thank you for purchasing the VoltEdge P200 wireless printer. {{1}} Please read them carefully before using the printer for the first time.

First, remove all tape and packing material from the printer. Then, connect the power cord and press the power button. When the light on the front panel turns green, the printer is ready {{2}} a network. Open the VoltEdge app on your computer or phone, and follow the steps on the screen to {{3}} the printer to your wireless network.

If the light turns red, turn the printer off and wait ten seconds before turning it on again. If the problem {{4}}, visit www.voltedgeprint.com/support or call our customer service team, which is available 24 hours a day.

o: Your printer will be delivered within five business days.
These instructions explain how to set up the device quickly.
Ink cartridges are sold separately at most stores.
This model was first introduced three years ago.
qs.ex: 下一句「Please read them carefully」的 them 需要複數指涉對象，正是 These instructions。Ink cartridges 雖為複數，但「使用前仔細閱讀墨水匣」不合邏輯。
be ready + to V 表示「準備好做某事」，故選 to join。ready joining 不合文法。
connect A to B 表示「將 A 連接到 B」，此處指把印表機連上無線網路。contact 是「聯絡（人）」，不用於連接設備。
條件副詞子句 If… 用現在式表示未來，故選 continues。will continue 違反「條件子句不用 will」的規則。

p6.title: Local bakery chain expands

qs.ex: 句尾 next month 表未來，且下一句「The new store … will be」也用未來式，故選 will open。opened 雖呼應關係子句中的 eight years ago，但那是第一家店，第五家店尚未開幕。
前句說顧客專程跨城買麵包（原因），此句說決定開一間離他們較近的店（結果），用 Therefore 表因果。However 表轉折，與前句沒有對比關係。

o: Ms. Lindqvist sold the company to a larger competitor last year.
The new shop is also expected to create about 25 jobs in the area.
Customers have often complained about the quality of the bread.
The bakery's first shop was opened by her parents in 1975.
qs.ex: 此句補充新店的另一項效益，接在擴店說明之後。其他選項與文意矛盾：文中她仍是 founder 並規劃課程、顧客對麵包有「strong demand」，且第一家店是「eight years ago」開設。
build a connection 是常見搭配，意為「建立連結」。attract 雖為及物動詞，但 attract a connection 不是自然用法；occur、succeed 為不及物動詞，不能直接接受詞。

p6.title: Nordway Software signs bank contract
p6.head:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Contact: Hana Sato, Media Relations, hsato@nordwaysoft.com

qs.ex: be valued at + 金額 表示「價值（估計為）…」，此處為分詞片語修飾 The contract。paid、spent 的對象是錢而非合約，earned 語意不符。

o: TeamClock was discontinued last year because of low sales.
It is also the first agreement the company has reached with a financial institution.
Applications for the position must be received by February 28.
The bank's spreadsheets will continue to be used at all branches.
qs.ex: It 指前句的 The contract，並以 also 補充其另一項意義（首次與金融機構合作）。TeamClock 已停產與文中正在導入的內容矛盾；試算表會繼續使用則與「All branches are expected to be using the system」矛盾。
be prone to + 名詞 表示「容易發生（不好的事）」，prone to errors 為固定搭配。likely 與 inclined 後須接 to + 原形動詞，不能直接接名詞 errors；tendency 為名詞。
空格後是名詞片語 the transition period，用介系詞 during 表「在…期間」。while 是連接詞，後面須接子句。

p6.title: Restaurant review: Casa Alvarez
p6.text:
Casa Alvarez, the new restaurant on Mercer Street, has quickly become one of the most talked-about places to eat in town. Chef Diego Alvarez, who previously worked in several well-known kitchens in Madrid, {{1}} traditional Spanish dishes with fresh local ingredients.

I visited on a busy Friday evening. Although every table was full, our server was attentive and our food arrived {{2}}. The grilled octopus was tender and full of flavor, and the seafood paella was large enough to share. The only {{3}} was the dessert menu, which offered just two choices.

Prices are reasonable, with most main dishes costing between $18 and $26. {{4}} Reservations can be made by phone or online at www.casaalvarez.com.

qs.ex: 主詞 Chef Diego Alvarez 後接插入的關係子句，主要子句仍缺動詞，故須用限定動詞 combines。combining 與 to combine 都不能當句子的主要動詞。
空格修飾不及物動詞 arrived，須用副詞 promptly。prompt 為形容詞，不能修飾動詞。
後文「which offered just two choices」帶有負面評價，且 The only… 暗示前面都很好，只有這點令人失望，故選 disappointment。highlight 與 advantage 皆為正面詞，與只有兩種選擇的負面語氣矛盾。

o: The restaurant is closed for renovations until further notice.
Because the restaurant is so popular, booking a table in advance is strongly recommended.
Chef Alvarez plans to open a second location in Madrid next year.
The dessert menu offers more than a dozen options.
qs.ex: 此句建議提前訂位，自然引出下一句「Reservations can be made by phone or online」。The dessert menu offers more than a dozen options 與前文「just two choices」矛盾。

p6.title: Interview invitation
p6.head:
To: Tom Becker <tbecker@quickmail.com>
From: Amara Okafor <aokafor@verdantlogistics.com>
Date: November 4
Subject: Interview for logistics coordinator position
p6.text:
Dear Mr. Becker,
Thank you for applying for the logistics coordinator position at Verdant Logistics. {{1}} We would therefore like to invite you to an interview at our main office, 500 Commerce Way, Suite 300.

The interview will take place on Thursday, November 13, at 10:00 A.M. You will meet with me and with Mr. Raj Patel, our operations director. Mr. Patel will also give you a brief tour of our warehouse facility. The interview {{2}} approximately one hour. Please bring a copy of your résumé and a list of three professional references.

{{3}} you are unable to attend at this time, please let me know by Friday so that we can arrange another date. I look forward to {{4}} you.

Best regards,
Amara Okafor
Human Resources

o: Unfortunately, the position has already been filled.
Our hiring committee was impressed with your experience in warehouse management.
We received your payment on October 30.
Your shipment is scheduled to arrive next week.
qs.ex: 下一句「We would therefore like to invite you to an interview」中的 therefore 需要前面有邀請面試的理由，即委員會對其經驗印象深刻。Unfortunately, the position has already been filled 與邀請面試矛盾。
信件日期為 November 4，面試在 November 13 才舉行，前句也用「will take place」，故用未來式 will last。lasted 為過去式，與尚未發生的面試不符。
「如果您無法出席，請告知」為條件句，用 If。Unless 意為「除非」，放入後變成「除非您無法出席，否則請告知」，語意顛倒。
look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後接動名詞 meeting。meet 為原形動詞，是常見陷阱。

p6.title: Energy-saving measures
p6.head:
To: All Employees
From: Greta Halvorsen, Operations Director
Date: January 22
Subject: Energy-saving measures

qs.ex: 前句指出電費「rose by nearly 18 percent」，推出節能措施的目的是「降低」這些開支，故選 reduce。increase 與節能目的相反。
上班時間設定 20°C，「而」夜間及週末降至 16°C，前後為對比，用 while。because 與 so 表因果，兩件事之間並無因果關係。

o: The motion sensors were removed from the meeting rooms last month.
Employees who work overtime will receive additional pay.
These changes alone are expected to save the company about $12,000 a year.
The cafeteria will now serve breakfast on weekdays.
qs.ex: These changes 指前面提到的感應燈與暖氣溫度調整，並說明其節省效益，與本文降低電費的主題一致。感應器上個月已被拆除與前文「will be connected to motion sensors」矛盾。
across the entire company 表示「在整個公司範圍內」。between 用於兩者之間，beside 表「在旁邊」，皆不合語意。

p6.title: Response to a product complaint
p6.head:
Clearwave Appliances
77 Industrial Parkway
Columbus, OH 43215

October 9

Mr. Lars Whitfield
42 Birch Lane
Dayton, OH 45402

Dear Mr. Whitfield,
p6.text:
Thank you for your letter of October 2 regarding the Clearwave blender you purchased last month. We are sorry to hear that the motor stopped working after only a few uses. This is certainly not the level of quality our customers have come to {{1}} from us.

Our technicians have reviewed the serial number you provided and confirmed that your unit was part of a batch with a known defect. {{2}}, we will send you a replacement blender at no charge. It should arrive within seven to ten business days. There is no need to return the original unit; you may {{3}} of it as you wish.

{{4}} As a further apology, we have enclosed a coupon for 25 percent off your next purchase at www.clearwaveappliances.com.

Sincerely,
Monica Reyes
Customer Care Manager

qs.ex: come to expect A from B 表示「（逐漸）期待從 B 得到 A」，指顧客對品質的期待。accept、except 字形相近但語意不符。
前句確認產品屬於有瑕疵的批次（原因），因此寄送替換品（結果），用 Accordingly（因此）。Nevertheless 表讓步轉折，與前句不構成對比。
dispose of 為固定搭配，意為「處理掉、丟棄」。discard 雖意思相近，但是及物動詞，不加 of。

o: Please return the defective unit in its original packaging.
Once again, please accept our apologies for the inconvenience.
Your refund has been deposited into your bank account.
Unfortunately, the blender you ordered is currently out of stock.
qs.ex: 空格後「As a further apology」中的 further 表示前面已經道歉過一次，故前句應為再次致歉。要求退回原機與「There is no need to return the original unit」矛盾；退款則與寄送替換品矛盾。

p6.title: Water service interruption
p6.text:
Attention, Residents of Maple Court Apartments:
Water service to the entire building will be shut off on Wednesday, August 6, from 9:00 A.M. to 3:00 P.M. During this time, plumbers will replace the main water valve, which {{1}} several leaks in recent weeks. {{2}}

We recommend that residents store enough water for drinking and cooking before the work begins. Please also make sure that all faucets are turned off; {{3}}, water may flow unexpectedly when service is restored.

We regret any inconvenience this may cause. If you have questions or concerns, please contact the building management office at 555-0142 or stop by Suite 101. Updates will be posted in the lobby {{4}} the work progresses.

qs.ex: in recent weeks 表示從過去延續到現在的期間，搭配現在完成式 has developed。is developing 不與 in recent weeks 這類完成期間連用表達「已出現數處漏水」。

o: Replacing it now will help prevent more serious damage to the building.
The swimming pool will reopen on Saturday after cleaning.
Residents are reminded that rent is due on the first of each month.
The leaks were successfully repaired last month.
qs.ex: it 指前句的 the main water valve，說明更換閥門的理由。The leaks were successfully repaired 與「several leaks in recent weeks」需要更換的情況矛盾。
「請確認水龍頭都已關閉；否則恢復供水時水可能會意外流出」，用 otherwise 表「否則」。therefore 表因果，但關水龍頭並不會導致水流出。
空格後是完整子句 the work progresses，須用連接詞 as（隨著）。during、throughout、despite 皆為介系詞，後面只能接名詞。

p6.title: Hive Commons coworking space
p6.text:
Tired of working from your kitchen table? Hive Commons offers freelancers and small businesses a professional workspace in the heart of downtown Melbourne. Our {{1}} designed office features fast Wi-Fi, private phone booths, and unlimited coffee and tea. Meeting rooms can also be reserved by the hour.

Members can choose from three flexible plans. The Day Pass, at $25, is ideal for those who need a desk only occasionally. The Resident plan, {{2}} includes a dedicated desk and storage locker, costs $390 per month. {{3}} This option is particularly popular with growing teams of up to six people.

Not sure which plan is right for you? Book a free tour at www.hivecommons.com.au and {{4}} a complimentary one-day pass.

qs.ex: 空格修飾過去分詞（形容詞）designed，須用副詞 thoughtfully。thoughtful 為形容詞，不能修飾另一個形容詞。
逗號後的非限定關係子句修飾 The Resident plan（事物），且子句缺主詞，故用 which。what 不能引導非限定關係子句。

o: The Day Pass can be purchased at the front desk.
Our café is open to the public on weekends.
Finally, the Team Suite provides a lockable private office for $1,450 per month.
Parking is available in the garage next door.
qs.ex: 前文說有「three flexible plans」，已介紹兩種，此句以 Finally 介紹第三種；下一句「This option is particularly popular with growing teams」正適合指私人辦公室方案。Day Pass 是給偶爾需要座位的人，不會特別受團隊歡迎。
and 連接兩個祈使句動詞，須與 Book 平行用原形 receive。to receive 破壞平行結構。

p6.title: Tessaro Textiles to modernize plant
p6.text:
RIDGEFIELD (March 18) — {{1}} The company confirmed on Monday that it will invest €14 million to upgrade the facility, which has produced upholstery fabric for more than four decades.

The upgrade, scheduled to begin in June, will replace much of the plant's aging machinery with automated looms capable of operating around the clock. Despite rumors of layoffs, company officials stressed that the project is not {{2}} at cutting jobs. {{3}}, the plant's workforce of 320 is expected to grow slightly, as Tessaro plans to add technician positions to maintain the new equipment.

Plant manager Elena Vasquez said that employees will receive paid training in operating the looms. "Our staff have decades of expertise," she noted. "The new technology will {{4}} that expertise, not replace it."

o: Tessaro Textiles announced that it will close its Ridgefield plant by the end of the year.
The plant's new looms have already doubled its output since they were installed.
Ms. Vasquez has been named the company's new chief executive officer.
Months of speculation about the future of Tessaro Textiles' Ridgefield plant have finally come to an end.
qs.ex: 文章開頭先點出「工廠前途的猜測終於結束」，再由「The company confirmed on Monday…」說明確定投資升級，後文「Despite rumors」也呼應此猜測。關廠與投資升級矛盾；新織機「已經」提升產量與「scheduled to begin in June」矛盾。
be aimed at + V-ing 為固定搭配，表示「旨在…」。intended 須接 to V 或 for；focused 須搭配 on，不與 at 連用。
前句否定「計畫旨在裁員」，此句提出相反事實「員工人數預計會小幅增加」，用 On the contrary（正好相反）。Even so 表讓步（即使如此），前句並未讓步，邏輯不通。
complement 意為「補足、相輔相成」，與「not replace it」形成對比：新技術是輔助而非取代員工專業。compliment（稱讚）拼字相近但語意不符；substitute 則與 not replace 矛盾。

p6.title: Meridian acquires Wren & Ash Hotels
p6.head:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Media contact: Oliver Grant, press@meridianhospitality.com

qs.ex: terms 屬於 the transaction（交易的條款），表所有關係用 whose。which 後接 terms were not disclosed 會缺少所有格連結；of that 不能用於非限定子句。
be essential to someone 表示「對某人至關重要」，與 from the very beginning 及保留原品牌的決定一致。indifferent 意為「不在乎」，與「Preserving the distinct character」的重視語氣相反。

o: All eleven properties will be rebranded as Meridian hotels next spring.
Meridian has also stated that it has no plans to change the hotels' staff or services.
Ms. Wren will step down once the transaction has been completed.
Meridian's loyalty program will be discontinued in January.
qs.ex: 下一段「Guests … will, however, soon notice one change」用 however 與前句的「不會改變」形成對比，故此處須說明不打算改變。更名與「continue to operate under their existing name」矛盾；Ms. Wren 卸任與「will remain in her role」矛盾。
助動詞 will 後接原形動詞，qualify for 表示「符合…資格」。qualified 為過去分詞，不能直接接在 will 後面。

p6.title: Global Logistics Summit registration

qs.ex: be eligible for + 名詞 表示「有資格獲得」。entitled 意思相近，但須搭配 to（be entitled to）；able 與 capable 分別接 to V 與 of，皆不與 for 搭配表此意。

o: Registration for the summit will open on February 28.
Members of the International Freight Association receive an additional 10 percent discount.
The early-bird rate also includes a two-night stay at a partner hotel.
Workshops are included in the standard fee at no extra cost.
qs.ex: 此句延續前句的報名費優惠，再補充會員額外折扣。報名將於 2/28 開放與「is now open」矛盾；含住宿與第三段飯店需另行預訂矛盾；工作坊免費包含則與「require a separate reservation」矛盾。
前句說所有方案皆包含主題演講等，此句說工作坊「卻」需另行預約，兩者對比，用 however。in addition 表追加，無法表達「不包含在內」的轉折。
前句規定最晚 April 1 前預訂，「在那天之後」未被預訂的房間將開放給一般大眾，用 After。Until 會變成截止前就釋出房間，與「book no later than April 1」的優惠期限矛盾。

p6.title: After-hours vehicle return

qs.ex: opposite 可直接作介系詞，opposite the main entrance 表「在正門對面」。adjacent 須接 to、in front 須接 of 才能表位置；beside 本身即介系詞，不加 of。
拍照存證是「以防」日後有人通報損傷，用 in case。so that 表目的，會變成拍照是為了讓損傷被通報，語意錯誤。
and 連接兩個祈使句動詞 place 與 deposit，須用原形保持平行結構。to deposit 會破壞平行。

o: Staff members will inspect the vehicle as soon as it is dropped off.
Keys should be handed directly to the office manager.

qs.ex: 前句說租期在隔天早上員工檢查後才結束，因此（therefore）在那之前車輛仍由顧客負責，that time 即指檢查時。立即檢查與「the following morning」矛盾；親手交鑰匙與放入 drop box 的程序矛盾。

p6.title: Book review: The Quiet Margin
p6.text:
{{1}} In The Quiet Margin, consultant Naomi Achterberg argues that most small businesses lose money not through dramatic mistakes but through dozens of minor inefficiencies that go unnoticed for years.

Each chapter examines one such inefficiency, from overlooked supplier fees to poorly timed inventory orders, and is {{2}} by a case study drawn from the author's twenty years of consulting work. These examples are the book's greatest strength. Rather than offering abstract advice, Achterberg shows exactly how real business owners identified and {{3}} each problem.

The book is not without flaws. The final two chapters, which address tax planning, are noticeably less detailed than the rest, and readers outside the United States may find them of limited use. {{4}}, The Quiet Margin is a practical and engaging guide that any small-business owner would benefit from reading.

o: Achterberg's previous book focused mainly on tax planning for large corporations.
Despite these limitations, the book is well worth reading.
These examples come from a wide range of industries.
Few business books manage to make the subject of cost control genuinely interesting.
qs.ex: 書評開頭以概括性評論引入主題，接著才以全名與頭銜「consultant Naomi Achterberg」首次介紹作者。若先用姓氏 Achterberg 提及作者則不自然；these limitations 與 These examples 在開頭都沒有可指涉的對象。
每一章「伴隨有」案例研究，主詞 Each chapter 與 accompany 為被動關係，且後有 by a case study，故用 is accompanied by。accompanying 會形成進行式主動，語意變成章節去陪伴案例。
identified and resolved each problem 表「找出並解決每個問題」，與本書提供實務解方的內容一致。resulted 為不及物動詞（result in/from），不能直接接受詞。
前文列出缺點「The book is not without flaws」，此句仍給予正面評價，用 Nonetheless（儘管如此）表讓步轉折。Therefore 表因果，缺點不會導致正面評價。

Alder Creek Lodge — Guest Reviews
Reviewed by: Jacqueline Moreau | Rating: 4 out of 5 stars | Posted: May 21
docs.body:
I recently stayed three nights at the Alder Creek Lodge while attending a training workshop in nearby Bend. The lodge is about a ten-minute drive from downtown, which was convenient for getting to my sessions each day.

My room was spacious and very clean, and the bed was comfortable. The only drawback was the Wi-Fi in the room, which was slow in the evenings when I needed to prepare for the next day's sessions. I ended up working in the lobby, where the connection was much stronger.

The breakfast buffet deserves special mention. Along with the usual eggs and pastries, it included fresh fruit from a local orchard and excellent coffee. The staff were friendly and even arranged an early taxi for me on my last morning so I could catch a 6:30 A.M. flight. I would definitely stay here again on my next business trip.

qs.q: What is suggested about Ms. Moreau?
o: She had stayed at the lodge before.
She did some work during her evenings at the lodge.
She missed her flight on the last day.
She traveled to Bend with several colleagues.
qs.ex: 她提到晚上「needed to prepare for the next day's sessions」，最後「ended up working in the lobby」，可推知她晚上在旅館工作，故選 (B)。她說會在下次出差「stay here again」，並未表示以前住過，(A) 錯。

o: The Internet connection in the guest rooms
qs.ex: 房間乾淨 (A)、咖啡很棒 (B)、員工幫忙叫車 (D) 都是優點；房內 Wi-Fi 則是「The only drawback」，屬缺點，故選 (C)。

Rachel will return to her regular duties.
Changes can no longer be made in the old database.
The new system will be shut down for testing.

docs.body:
When graphic designer Mariana Costa started her own studio three years ago, she rented a small office downtown. Today, she and her four employees work from Hive Commons, a shared workspace on the east side of Columbus. [1] "We pay about 30 percent less than we did before," Costa said, "and we have access to meeting rooms and a print center that we could never afford on our own."

Costa's studio is one of a growing number of small businesses choosing flexible workspaces over traditional leases. According to a recent survey by the Midwest Commercial Real Estate Council, the number of shared office spaces in the region has risen by 45 percent since 2022. [2]

Operators say the appeal goes beyond cost. Many members value the chance to meet professionals from other fields. [3] Costa, for example, found her accountant and two new clients through events held at Hive Commons.

However, shared spaces are not for everyone. Firms that handle confidential information, such as law offices, often require private rooms that can be difficult to secure in busy facilities. [4] Noise can also be a concern for employees who spend much of the day on the phone.

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
o: The rising cost of downtown office rentals
A survey of graphic design studios in Columbus
How law firms protect confidential information
The growing popularity of shared workspaces among small firms
qs.ex: 文章以 Costa 為例，說明「a growing number of small businesses choosing flexible workspaces」，並分析優缺點，故選 (D)。法律事務所只是說明缺點時舉的例子，(C) 錯。

qs.q: What is implied about law offices?
o: They need spaces where private matters can be discussed.
They make up the largest group of Hive Commons members.
They pay higher fees than other members of shared spaces.
They often organize networking events for other businesses.
qs.ex: 文中說處理機密資訊的公司如「law offices, often require private rooms」，暗示他們需要能私下討論的空間，故選 (A)。文中未提及費用高低或會員比例，(B)(C) 無根據。

qs.q: The word "secure" in paragraph 4, line 3, is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: 「private rooms that can be difficult to secure in busy facilities」指在熱門場地很難「取得、訂到」私人房間，secure 等於 obtain，故選 (B)。protect 是 secure 的常見意思「保護」，但不符合此處語境。

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Most of them offer monthly memberships rather than the multiyear contracts typical of conventional office rentals."
qs.ex: 「Most of them」需指涉複數的共享辦公空間；[2] 前句正是「the number of shared office spaces in the region has risen」，且月租制說明了「flexible workspaces over traditional leases」，故選 (B)。[3] 前的 them 會指 members，而會員不會「offer memberships」。

Media Contact: Lucy Tran, ltran@northwindair.com
docs.body:
CHICAGO (March 3) — Northwind Air today announced that it will launch daily nonstop flights between Chicago and Lisbon, Portugal, beginning June 1. The route will be the airline's first to southern Europe and will be served by its newest wide-body aircraft, which seats 280 passengers.

"Lisbon has become one of the most popular destinations among our frequent flyers," said Harold Brennan, vice president of network planning. "This new service makes it easier for both business and leisure travelers to reach Portugal without connecting through another city."

Flights will depart Chicago at 6:15 P.M. and arrive in Lisbon at 8:40 A.M. the following morning, local time. Return flights will leave Lisbon at 11:30 A.M. Passengers in business class will enjoy fully flat seats and meals prepared with ingredients from Portuguese farms.

To mark the launch, Northwind Rewards members who book a round-trip ticket by April 15 will earn double miles on their journey. Tickets go on sale this Friday at www.northwindair.com.

qs.q: What is suggested about Northwind Air?
o: It plans to reduce flights to other cities.
It recently merged with another airline.
It has not previously offered service to southern Europe.
qs.ex: 新聞稿說新航線是「the airline's first to southern Europe」，可推知該公司之前沒有飛南歐，故選 (D)。新聞稿發自芝加哥，沒有證據顯示總部在葡萄牙，(A) 錯。

qs.q: According to Mr. Brennan, why was Lisbon chosen as a destination?
o: It is the least expensive city to fly to in Europe.
It is popular with the airline's regular customers.
Many business conferences are held there.
Northwind Air recently opened an office there.
qs.ex: Mr. Brennan 說「Lisbon has become one of the most popular destinations among our frequent flyers」，frequent flyers 即常客，故選 (B)。他雖提到商務旅客，但未提及會議，(C) 錯。

qs.q: The word "mark" in paragraph 4, line 1, is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: 「To mark the launch」指為了慶祝新航線開航，mark 等於 celebrate，故選 (A)。label（標示）與 grade（評分）是 mark 的其他意思，不符合此處語境。

qs.q: What will Northwind Rewards members receive if they book by April 15?
o: A free upgrade to business class
A discount on a one-way ticket
Twice the usual number of miles
Priority boarding on the first flight
qs.ex: 「members who book a round-trip ticket by April 15 will earn double miles」，double miles 即兩倍里程，故選 (C)。條件是來回票，不是單程折扣，(B) 錯。

o: By visiting another section of the Web site

docs.head: VANTREX POSTS MIXED THIRD-QUARTER RESULTS
docs.body:
MILWAUKEE (October 24) — Vantrex Appliances, the Milwaukee-based maker of kitchen and laundry equipment, reported on Thursday that third-quarter revenue rose 7 percent from a year earlier, to $412 million. Profit, however, fell to $18.6 million from $24.1 million, as higher steel prices and the cost of opening a new distribution center in Reno weighed on margins.

Sales of the company's premium Arctis refrigerator line were particularly strong, climbing 19 percent and accounting for nearly a third of total revenue. Chief Executive Officer Danielle Okonkwo attributed the growth to the line's energy-saving features, which qualify buyers for rebates in several states. By contrast, demand for washing machines remained flat, which Ms. Okonkwo described as "disappointing but not surprising" given the slowdown in new home construction.

Analysts had expected a profit of around $20 million, and Vantrex shares dropped 4 percent in early trading before recovering most of the loss by the close. "Investors are clearly weighing short-term costs against long-term capacity," said Luis Barreto, an analyst at Harlow Securities. "Once the Reno facility is fully operational, shipping times to West Coast retailers should improve considerably."

The company maintained its full-year revenue forecast of $1.6 billion but lowered its profit outlook slightly. Ms. Okonkwo also confirmed that Vantrex is in talks to supply built-in appliances to a national homebuilder, though she declined to name the firm. An agreement, if reached, would be the largest contract in the company's 41-year history.

Vantrex will release its fourth-quarter results in late January.

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
o: The opening of a distribution center in Milwaukee
A dispute between an appliance maker and a homebuilder
Changes to state rebates for efficient appliances
The recent financial results of a manufacturer
qs.ex: 全文圍繞 Vantrex「reported ... third-quarter revenue」、獲利、股價與財測，主旨是公司最新財報。新物流中心在 Reno 而非 Milwaukee；與建商是「in talks」洽談合作，並非糾紛。

qs.q: What is implied about the Reno distribution center?
o: It is not yet operating at full capacity.
It was built mainly to serve Midwest customers.
It caused Vantrex's revenue to decline.
It will be sold to a homebuilder.
qs.ex: 分析師說「Once the Reno facility is fully operational」，暗示目前尚未全面運作。文中說開設成本壓縮的是利潤（margins），營收其實成長 7%；該中心是為了縮短運往 West Coast 的時間，而非中西部。

qs.q: The word "flat" in paragraph 2, line 4, is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: 「demand for washing machines remained flat」與前句冰箱銷售成長 19% 形成對比（By contrast），指需求「持平、沒有變化」。fixed in price 取自 flat fee（固定費用）之意，與需求量無關。

qs.q: What is NOT stated about Vantrex?
o: Its profit was below analysts' expectations.
It may soon sign its largest-ever contract.
It has raised its annual revenue forecast.
qs.ex: 文中說公司「maintained its full-year revenue forecast」，是維持而非上調，且獲利預估還略為下修。股價先跌後回升、獲利 $18.6M 低於預期的約 $20M、可能簽下史上最大合約，皆有提及。

Tidewater Press Invites Submissions for Annual Regional Anthology
docs.body:
HALIFAX (March 2) — Tidewater Press, an independent publisher of fiction and nonfiction from Atlantic Canada, is now accepting submissions for the fifth edition of its anthology Salt Lines, scheduled for release next spring. [1] This year's theme is "Crossings," which the editors hope writers will interpret broadly, whether as a physical journey, a change in career, or a shift between languages and cultures.

Writers who currently live in New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, or Newfoundland and Labrador are eligible to apply. [2] Both short stories and personal essays will be considered, provided they are between 2,000 and 6,000 words and have not appeared previously in print or online. Each writer may submit only one piece. Unlike in past years, there is no submission fee.

Selected contributors will receive a payment of $500, two copies of the book, and an invitation to read at the launch event at the Halifax Central Library. [3] In addition, one contributor whose work has never before been published will be chosen for a six-month mentorship with novelist Aidan Cormier, whose debut novel won the Marlowe Prize in 2019.

"We created Salt Lines to give new and established voices equal space on the page," said Editorial Director Ingrid Solberg. "Some of our earliest contributors have since gone on to publish books of their own." [4]

Submissions must be uploaded through the form at www.tidewaterpress.com/saltlines by 11:59 P.M. on May 31. Writers will be notified of the editors' decisions by the end of August.

o: Writers living in certain Canadian provinces

Members of the Halifax Central Library

Growing Up: Local Firm Turns Rooftops into Revenue
By Colin Ashby, Staff Writer
docs.body:
When Nadia Petrova founded SkyCrop Farms four years ago, she had one rooftop greenhouse, two employees, and a handful of restaurant clients. Today the Chicago company operates eleven rooftop sites across the city and supplies leafy greens and herbs to more than 90 restaurants and three grocery chains.

Ms. Petrova, who previously worked as a structural engineer, says her background has been essential. "Most building owners like the idea of a rooftop farm, but they worry about weight and water," she explained. "Being able to walk them through the engineering in detail is often what wins their trust." SkyCrop leases roof space from property owners, typically paying a modest rent while also covering the cost of any reinforcement work. In return, owners gain improved insulation, which can noticeably reduce heating and cooling bills.

The company's hydroponic system uses about 90 percent less water than conventional farming, and because produce travels only a few miles to customers, it is usually harvested and delivered on the same day. Chef Marcus Webb of the restaurant Larkspur says the difference is obvious. "The basil arrives with the roots still on. It lasts nearly a week longer than what we used to get."

Growth has not come without obstacles. Winter heating costs remain high, and last year a hailstorm damaged two greenhouses, forcing SkyCrop to buy produce from other growers for several weeks to fulfill orders. The company has since installed impact-resistant panels at all locations.

SkyCrop plans to open sites in Milwaukee and Detroit next year, funded in part by a recent $6 million investment. Ms. Petrova is also exploring partnerships with schools that want students to learn about food production.

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
o: A new regulation affecting Chicago building owners
The expansion of a city-based farming company
The career of a well-known restaurant chef
Ways to lower heating costs in greenhouses
qs.ex: 文章介紹 SkyCrop Farms 從一座溫室發展到「eleven rooftop sites」及未來展店計畫，主旨是都市農業公司的成長。主廚 Marcus Webb 只是受訪客戶，冬季暖氣費則是公司面臨的困難之一。

qs.q: The word "wins" in paragraph 2, line 5, is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: 「what wins their trust」指「贏得、獲得」屋主的信任，與 earns 同義。defeats 與 finishes first in 是比賽獲勝的意思，不符合此處語境。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned as an advantage of SkyCrop's approach?
o: Lower energy bills for building owners
qs.ex: 文中提到用水量少 90%、羅勒「lasts nearly a week longer」、屋主因隔熱改善而「reduce heating and cooling bills」，但從未提到價格比傳統農產品便宜。

qs.ex: 冰雹損毀溫室，「forcing SkyCrop to buy produce from other growers for several weeks to fulfill orders」，表示當時無法靠自家作物供應所有訂單。溫室是受損而非永久關閉；Milwaukee 據點明年才開設。

What if something breaks during my shoot?
Call our 24-hour support line at 555-0163 right away. In many cases, our technicians can resolve the problem over the phone. If they cannot, we will deliver replacement equipment anywhere within 40 miles of our Burbank warehouse at no charge, or courier it farther for a fee. Please do not attempt to repair any item yourself, as doing so may void your coverage.

Do you offer discounts?
Students enrolled in accredited film programs receive 15 percent off all rentals. Productions booking for ten or more consecutive days should contact our sales team for a custom quote.

qs.q: What is NOT required of a first-time customer at pickup?
qs.ex: 首次租用須出示「government-issued photo ID, a valid credit card ... and a certificate of insurance」，並未要求現金押金。

qs.q: How will a customer be billed for equipment picked up at 3:00 P.M. on a Friday and returned at 9:30 A.M. the following Monday?
qs.ex: 週五下午 2 點後取件、週一上午 10 點前歸還，「are billed as a single day」，所以只算一天。實際跨了三個晚上，但不能按天數計算。

qs.q: What is suggested about a customer who returns equipment one hour late?
o: The customer will pay an hourly late fee.
The customer will be charged for an additional full day.
The customer will lose a student discount.
The customer must call the support line.
qs.ex: 網頁說逾時歸還「is charged at the full daily rate, no matter how late it is」，可推知即使只晚一小時也要多付一整天的費用，並非按小時計費。

docs.body:
Yusuf Demir [2:31 P.M.]: Celeste, the glass panels for the Ashford Library lobby won't be delivered Thursday. The fabricator found a flaw in the coating and is remaking the whole batch.
Celeste Moreau [2:33 P.M.]: How long are we looking at?
Yusuf Demir [2:34 P.M.]: They're saying the 14th at the earliest.
Celeste Moreau [2:36 P.M.]: That pushes the installation crew back a full week, and they're booked on another job after that.
Yusuf Demir [2:38 P.M.]: I know. I asked whether they could ship the panels for the north wall first, since those are a different size and come from a separate production line. They might have those ready by Monday.
Celeste Moreau [2:39 P.M.]: Now we're talking. If the crew can start on the north wall, we'd only lose a couple of days overall.
Yusuf Demir [2:41 P.M.]: I'll confirm with the fabricator this afternoon. Should I let the library director know about the delay?
Celeste Moreau [2:42 P.M.]: Not yet. Let's wait until we have firm dates. I'd rather give her one update than three.
Yusuf Demir [2:43 P.M.]: Makes sense. I'll call you as soon as I hear back.

qs.q: At 2:39 P.M., what does Ms. Moreau most likely mean when she writes, "Now we're talking"?
o: She wants to discuss the problem in person.
She has already spoken with the installation crew.
She thinks Mr. Demir's idea is promising.
She believes the fabricator should be replaced.
qs.ex: Mr. Demir 提議先出貨北牆的玻璃，她回「Now we're talking」並說這樣「we'd only lose a couple of days」，表示這個辦法可行、很好。這句口語並非字面上「要開始談」的意思。

qs.q: Why will the panels be delivered late?
o: A defect was discovered in them.
qs.ex: 「The fabricator found a flaw in the coating and is remaking the whole batch」，flaw 即 defect。安裝團隊之後另有工作是延誤造成的後果，而非原因。

qs.q: What is suggested about Ms. Moreau?
o: She is the director of the Ashford Library.
She plans to hire a different installation crew.
She will visit the fabricator on Monday.
She wants confirmed information before contacting a client.
qs.ex: 她說「Let's wait until we have firm dates. I'd rather give her one update than three」，表示要等日期確定再通知圖書館館長（客戶）。館長是她要聯絡的「her」，並非她本人。

docs.head:
To: All Employees
From: Anjali Mehta, Chief Financial Officer
Date: August 18
Subject: Updates to travel policy
docs.body:
Effective September 1, Halvorsen Engineering will introduce several changes to its business travel policy. These changes are the result of a review conducted over the summer, during which the finance department compared our practices with those of firms of similar size.

First, a fixed daily meal allowance will replace the current system of reimbursing actual meal expenses. Employees traveling within the country will receive $65 per day, and those traveling internationally will receive an amount based on the destination city, as listed on the finance page of the intranet. Receipts for meals will no longer need to be submitted, which should considerably reduce the time spent preparing expense reports.

Second, all flights must now be booked through our travel agency, Meridian Corporate Travel, unless the traveler can find a fare at least 10 percent lower elsewhere. In such cases, a screenshot of the Meridian quote must accompany the expense report. Business-class tickets will continue to be permitted only for flights longer than eight hours.

Third, employees who use their personal vehicles for work will be reimbursed at a revised rate of $0.62 per mile, up from $0.55. Mileage logs must be submitted within 30 days of the trip in order to be honored.

Finally, hotel stays should not exceed the nightly limits posted on the intranet. Stays above these limits require advance written approval from a department head.

A short information session will be held on August 27 at 4:00 P.M. in the main auditorium and streamed for staff at the Portland and Boise offices. Questions may also be directed to finance@halvorsen-eng.com.

qs.q: Under the new policy, when may an employee book a flight without using Meridian Corporate Travel?
o: When the flight is longer than eight hours
When a significantly cheaper fare is available
When a department head gives written approval
When the destination is outside the country
qs.ex: 備忘錄說須透過 Meridian 訂票，「unless the traveler can find a fare at least 10 percent lower elsewhere」。八小時是商務艙的條件，部門主管書面核准則是針對超出上限的住宿。

qs.q: The word "honored" in paragraph 4, line 3, is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: 「Mileage logs must be submitted within 30 days ... in order to be honored」指里程紀錄須在期限內提交才會「被受理、予以支付」。respected 與 given an award 是 honor 的一般意思，不符合報帳語境。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned as a change that takes effect on September 1?
o: Meal receipts will no longer be required.
Business-class travel will be limited to long flights.
A daily meal allowance will be introduced.
qs.ex: 商務艙「will continue to be permitted only for flights longer than eight hours」，continue 表示這是沿用舊規定，並非新變更。免附餐費收據、里程費率由 $0.55 調升至 $0.62、改採每日餐費定額，都是新措施。

p7.title: Invitation to judge a design prize

docs.head:
Kestrel Design Foundation
1450 Market Street, Suite 300
San Francisco, CA 94103

June 2

Mr. Haruto Yamada
Yamada Studio
3-8-14 Jingumae, Shibuya-ku
Tokyo 150-0001, Japan
docs.body:
Dear Mr. Yamada,

On behalf of the Kestrel Design Foundation, I am pleased to invite you to serve as a judge for this year's Kestrel Prize for Sustainable Product Design. [1] Your work on modular furniture made from recycled aluminum, particularly the Fold series exhibited in Milan last year, has been widely praised by our board, and we believe your perspective would be invaluable.

This year, we received 312 entries from 27 countries, nearly double last year's total. A preliminary committee is currently narrowing the field to 20 finalists, whose submissions will be sent to the judges by August 15. [2] The five judges will then meet in person in San Francisco on September 18 and 19 to examine physical prototypes and select a winner, as well as two honorable mentions.

The foundation will cover your round-trip business-class airfare, three nights' accommodation at the Alder Hotel, and all meals during your stay. [3] Judges also receive an honorarium of $3,000. In addition, we would be honored if you would give a brief talk at the awards ceremony on the evening of September 20, although this is entirely optional.

We would appreciate your reply by June 20. [4] Should your schedule not permit you to travel, we would still welcome your participation as a remote reviewer during the preliminary stage, for which a reduced honorarium would apply.

Sincerely,

Rebecca Thornton
Executive Director

qs.q: What is the purpose of the letter?
o: To announce the winner of a design award
To request that Mr. Yamada enter a competition
To invite Mr. Yamada to exhibit his work in Milan
To ask Mr. Yamada to help select a prize winner
qs.ex: 信中說「I am pleased to invite you to serve as a judge」，即請他擔任評審協助選出得獎者。干擾選項 B 把「評審」扭曲為「參賽」；Milan 是他去年展出作品的地點。

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Each judge will be asked to score these designs online in advance of the in-person sessions."
qs.ex: 「these designs」須指具體作品，[2] 前一句提到 20 件決選作品「will be sent to the judges by August 15」，後一句接著說評審 9 月實體開會，時間順序也吻合。[1] 之前尚未提到任何作品。

qs.q: What is Mr. Yamada asked to do by June 20?
qs.ex: 信中說「We would appreciate your reply by June 20」。旅館由基金會負擔安排，演講則是「entirely optional」，且沒有 6 月 20 日的期限。

qs.q: What is implied about Mr. Yamada?
o: He has served as a judge for the prize before.
He may participate even if he cannot travel to San Francisco.
He is a member of the foundation's board.
He will be required to speak at the awards ceremony.
qs.ex: 信末說若無法出差，「we would still welcome your participation as a remote reviewer」，所以即使不能前往仍可參與。董事會只是稱讚他的作品，他並非成員；演講是自由選擇而非義務。

docs.head: Riverside Symphony Orchestra Announces Changes to Subscription Packages
docs.body:
For more than three decades, subscribers have been the foundation of the Riverside Symphony Orchestra. As we prepare for our 2027 season at the newly renovated Calloway Concert Hall, we are introducing several changes designed to give subscribers greater flexibility. [1]

In place of our traditional fixed series, subscribers will now be able to build their own packages by selecting any five or more concerts from the season. [2] Those who choose eight or more concerts will receive a 20 percent discount off single-ticket prices, compared with 12 percent for five to seven concerts. Ticket exchanges, which previously required 72 hours' notice, can now be made online up to two hours before a performance at no charge.

The renovation has reduced the hall's capacity from 2,400 to 2,050 seats in order to provide wider rows and improved sight lines. [3] Current subscribers will have priority to renew their seats until February 14. After that date, any unclaimed seats will be released to new subscribers and to the general public.

Subscribers will also be invited to an open rehearsal with guest conductor Mateo Ilunga in April, along with a backstage tour of the renovated hall. [4]

Renewal forms have been mailed to all current subscribers. Packages may also be purchased at www.riversidesymphony.org or by calling the box office at 555-0129, Tuesday through Saturday, from noon to 6:00 P.M.

qs.q: How can subscribers receive the largest discount?
o: By selecting at least eight concerts
qs.ex: 公告說「Those who choose eight or more concerts will receive a 20 percent discount」，選五到七場只有 12%。2 月 14 日是續訂原座位的優先期限，與折扣無關。

qs.q: The word "foundation" in paragraph 1, line 1, is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: 「subscribers have been the foundation of the ... Orchestra」指訂戶是樂團的「基礎、支柱」，與 basis 同義。charity 與 institution 是 foundation 作「基金會、機構」時的意思，不符合此處語境。

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"As a result, some current subscribers may need to choose new seat locations."
qs.ex: 「As a result」須承接造成座位變動的原因；[3] 前一句提到整修使座位「reduced the hall's capacity from 2,400 to 2,050 seats」，因此部分訂戶可能須改選座位，後句再說明續訂優先期限。[4] 前一句講彩排與後台導覽，與座位數無因果關係。

From: Lena Fischer <lfischer@fischerdesignco.com>
Date: May 20
Subject: Membership inquiry
docs.body:
Hello,

My small graphic design firm is moving to Portland in June, and I am looking for a workspace for myself and two colleagues. Because we use expensive equipment, we need a room that can be secured when we leave at night.

We also meet with clients regularly, so I expect we will need a meeting room for about eight hours each month. Could you also tell me whether parking is available nearby for our visitors?
