qs.q: According to the advertisement, what is included in every membership?
qs.ex: 廣告寫「Every membership includes high-speed Internet, unlimited coffee and tea, and mail handling」，mail handling 即協助收發郵件。會議室每月只有五小時免費，並非無限使用，停車位與置物櫃文中皆未提及。

qs.q: In the e-mail, paragraph 1, line 2, the word "secured" is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: 「a room that can be secured when we leave at night」指晚上離開時能把房間鎖上，故為 locked。secure 雖也有「取得」(obtained) 之意，但此處語境是保全設備，不是取得房間。

qs.q: Why did Ms. Fischer write the e-mail?
o: To complain about a meeting room
To offer design services to Harborview Workspace
To ask about renting space for her business
qs.ex: 她說公司將搬到 Portland，「I am looking for a workspace for myself and two colleagues」，目的是詢問租用辦公空間。她雖經營設計公司，但並非向對方推銷設計服務。

qs.q: How much will Ms. Fischer's firm most likely pay each month for additional meeting-room time?
qs.ex: 電子郵件說每月約需「about eight hours」會議室；廣告寫會員每月有「five free hours」，超過的「billed at $25 per hour」，故 3 小時 × $25 = $75。$200 是誤把八小時全部計費。

qs.q: What problem will Ms. Fischer most likely encounter with her plans?
o: The Private Office cannot hold three people.
The building will be closed in June.
Tours are not offered on the day she wants to visit.
Parking is not available near the building.
qs.ex: 她希望在「Saturday, May 25」參觀，但廣告寫「Tours are available Monday through Friday」，週六沒有導覽。Private Office 可容納「up to four people」，三人沒問題；停車資訊文中並未說明。

48 Queen Street West, Apt. 7
Toronto, ON M5H 2M9
April 9
docs.body:
Dear Mr. Delgado,

I am writing to apply for the event coordinator position advertised on your Web site. For four years, until last month, I worked as an assistant events manager at the Grandview Hotel in Ottawa, where I organized weddings, awards dinners, and sales conferences for groups of up to 400 guests.

qs.q: What is indicated about the event coordinator position?
o: It sometimes requires working outside regular business hours.
It includes free meals at the center.
It requires a degree in hospitality.
qs.ex: 條件寫「Ability to work some evenings and weekends」，表示有時需在正常上班時間以外工作。職缺為「full-time」，不是兼職；hospitality 只出現在經驗要求，並未要求學位。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned as a benefit of the job?
qs.ex: 徵才廣告列出「a competitive salary, health insurance, and free on-site parking」，三者皆有提及，唯獨帶薪休假未提到。

qs.q: What is suggested about Ms. Raman?
o: She has experience handling events for large groups.
She has worked with Mr. Delgado before.
She was the manager of a hotel in Montreal.
qs.ex: 她曾為「groups of up to 400 guests」籌辦活動，可推知有處理大型團體活動的經驗。她最近才搬到 Toronto 且「available to start immediately」，並非目前在 Toronto 任職；Montreal 只是她成長的地方。

qs.q: Which qualification does Ms. Raman have that the job posting describes as desirable but not required?
qs.ex: 徵才廣告寫「Fluency in French is a plus」（加分條件），信中說她「comfortable working with clients in both English and French」。預算能力與三年經驗都是必要條件，不是加分項。

qs.q: What is indicated about Ms. Raman's application?
o: It was sent before the deadline.
It did not include the required references.
It was addressed to the wrong person.
It was submitted after interviews had begun.
qs.ex: 信件日期為「April 9」，而廣告要求「by April 15」申請，故在截止前寄出。她附上「two former supervisors」的聯絡資料，即兩位推薦人，並未缺件；收件人 Mr. Delgado 也正確。

qs.q: According to the invoice, why was the customer not charged for delivery?
o: The customer picked up the items in person.

The order total exceeded a certain amount.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
o: To report problems with a delivery
To request a copy of an invoice
To ask for an extension on a payment deadline
qs.ex: 信中說「I noticed two problems」，接著說明碳粉匣少送一個、椅子輪子損壞，目的是反映到貨問題。她雖提到發票，但不是索取發票副本。

qs.q: In the e-mail, paragraph 3, line 2, the word "remove" is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: 「remove the cost of the missing and damaged items from our bill」指從帳單中扣除費用，故為 deduct。transport 是「移走物品」的意思，dismiss 是「解雇、駁回」，皆不合語境。

qs.q: Why might Brightline Office Supply be unable to accept a return of the damaged chair under its standard policy?
o: More than 14 days have passed since the delivery.
The chair was not listed on the invoice.
The chair was purchased at a discount.
The chair's packaging has already been opened.
qs.ex: 發票規定「Items may be returned unopened within 14 days」，但電子郵件說「Its box has been opened」。貨物 9 月 5 日送達、9 月 8 日寄信，未超過 14 天，所以時間不是問題。

qs.q: In the memo, paragraph 2, line 2, the word "proceed" is closest in meaning to

Rating: 4 out of 5 stars
docs.body:
My husband and I stayed at Cedar Ridge Inn from Sunday, October 6, to Wednesday, October 9, and we brought our dog, Biscuit, along. Our room was clean and comfortable, and the view from the balcony was spectacular, especially at sunrise.

It has a restaurant open to the public.
Every guest room has a balcony.

qs.ex: 評論稱讚房間「clean and comfortable」、景色「spectacular」、早餐「excellent」，但完全沒有提到員工服務。

qs.q: What type of room did Ms. Kowalczyk most likely stay in?
qs.ex: 評論說她們帶了狗「we brought our dog」，而網頁規定「Pets are welcome in Standard Queen rooms only」，因此應住 Standard Queen。所有房間都有陽台，故最後一項錯誤。

qs.q: What is indicated about Ms. Kowalczyk's stay?
o: She paid weekend rates for one night.
She paid an extra $30 to leave late.
She received a discount on the total cost.
qs.ex: 她週日入住、週三退房，共住三晚，符合網頁「three or more consecutive nights ... 15 percent off」的折扣。三晚皆為週日至週二的平日價；她想延遲退房卻「no rooms were available」，所以沒有付 $30。

qs.q: What is implied about Ms. Kowalczyk?
o: She would consider staying at the inn again.
She has stayed at the inn several times before.
She was dissatisfied with her room.
qs.ex: 評論最後寫「Even so, we would happily return」，暗示她願意再次入住。她對房間評價是「clean and comfortable」，並無不滿；文中也未說她以前來過。

It was originally proposed by Fairmont Furniture.
It follows the building's guidance for that day.
It will require assistance from Pinnacle Plumbing.

qs.q: In the letter, paragraph 2, line 2, the word "disbursed" is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: 「Funds will be disbursed in two equal installments」指款項分兩期「撥付」，故為 paid out。spread around 只是字面上「分散」，不符合撥款的意思。

qs.q: Why most likely does Ms. Brennan ask Mr. Alvarez to bring photographs?
o: To document the building's condition before work begins
To use them in a council advertisement
To prove that the work has been completed
To confirm how long he has operated his business
qs.ex: 她要求帶「photographs of the storefront as it currently appears」，即施工前現況，可推知是為了記錄改善前的樣貌。完工確認是由「our inspector」負責，與照片無關。

qs.q: What must happen before Mr. Alvarez can begin replacing the awning?
o: An inspector must approve his choice of paint colors.
He must pay half of the project cost to the council.
The council must receive a revised cost estimate.
He must finalize an agreement with the council.

docs.head: Announcement from Quillbase — Changes to Our Subscription Plans
docs.body:
Effective January 1, Quillbase will restructure its project-management subscriptions. The Starter plan, currently $8 per user per month, will be discontinued. Existing Starter customers will be moved automatically to the Team plan at their current rate for the first six months, after which the standard Team rate of $12 per user per month will apply.

The Team plan will continue to support up to 25 users and include 100 GB of shared storage. The Business plan, at $20 per user per month, will now include unlimited storage and advanced reporting tools, features previously sold as add-ons.

Customers who prefer to switch plans before January 1 can do so from the Billing page of their account. Annual subscribers who pay in advance receive two months free on any plan.

Sofia Marchetti [2:03 P.M.]: Did everyone see Quillbase's announcement? We're on Starter, so we'll be switched over in January.
Tom Becker [2:05 P.M.]: I saw it. The price stays the same until summer, and then it goes up by half.
Ji-woo Han [2:06 P.M.]: That's not my main concern. We hired four people this quarter, so we're at 27 users now.
Sofia Marchetti [2:07 P.M.]: Good point. That rules out the plan they're putting us on.
Tom Becker [2:09 P.M.]: And we've been paying extra for reporting tools anyway. The higher tier might not cost much more overall.
Sofia Marchetti [2:10 P.M.]: Tom, could you run the numbers, including the annual payment option?
Tom Becker [2:11 P.M.]: Will do. I'll have something by Friday.

qs.q: According to the announcement, what will happen to existing Starter customers?
o: They will receive unlimited storage at no extra charge.
They must choose a new plan by January 1 or lose access.
They will temporarily keep their current price under a different plan.
They will automatically receive two months of free service.
qs.ex: 公告寫 Starter 客戶將「moved automatically to the Team plan at their current rate for the first six months」，即在新方案下暫時維持原價。兩個月免費只適用於「Annual subscribers who pay in advance」；是自動轉換，不會失去使用權。

qs.q: What is NOT indicated about the Business plan?
o: It costs $20 per user per month.
It supports a maximum of 25 users.
It will include advanced reporting tools.
qs.ex: 「up to 25 users」是 Team plan 的限制，公告並未說 Business plan 有人數上限。其餘三項皆見「The Business plan, at $20 per user per month, will now include unlimited storage and advanced reporting tools」。

qs.q: At 2:07 P.M., what does Ms. Marchetti most likely mean when she writes, "That rules out the plan they're putting us on"?
o: The Team plan cannot accommodate all of the company's users.
The company cannot afford the Business plan.
The Starter plan will no longer be offered.
The company will not be switched until summer.
qs.ex: Ms. Han 說公司現有「27 users」，而公告指出要被轉入的 Team plan 只支援「up to 25 users」，所以她的意思是 Team plan 人數不夠用。Starter 停售雖為事實，但不是這句話要表達的重點。

qs.q: Why does Mr. Becker think the Business plan may not be much more expensive overall?
o: It offers a discount to companies with more than 25 users.
It costs the same as the Starter plan for six months.
It is cheaper when purchased through the Billing page.
It includes a feature the company currently pays for separately.
qs.ex: Mr. Becker 說「we've been paying extra for reporting tools」，而公告指出 Business plan 將包含「advanced reporting tools, features previously sold as add-ons」，省下加購費用。維持原價六個月是轉入 Team plan 的條件，不適用於 Business plan。

qs.q: What will Mr. Becker most likely include in the information he prepares by Friday?
o: The cost of canceling the company's reporting tools
A plan for hiring additional staff
The effect of receiving two free months for paying a year in advance
A request to Quillbase for a lower rate
qs.ex: Ms. Marchetti 請他計算時「including the annual payment option」，而公告說「Annual subscribers who pay in advance receive two months free」，所以他的試算應會納入預付年費可免費兩個月的影響。其他選項聊天中未提及。

docs.head:
Riverton Gazette — May 4
Calloway Mill to Become Community Hub
docs.body:
RIVERTON — The city council voted 6–1 on Tuesday to approve a $4.2 million plan to renovate the former Calloway textile mill on Fenner Street. The building, which has stood empty since 2014, will house a branch library, a small-business incubator, and a 120-seat event hall.

Construction is expected to begin in August and take about 18 months. Funding will come from a state historic preservation grant and the city's capital improvement budget. "This project preserves an important part of Riverton's history while meeting modern needs," said council member Alma Reyes, who proposed the plan.

The design includes a rooftop garden but no on-site parking, since the mill sits two blocks from the Fenner Street bus station.

docs.head: Letters to the Editor — Riverton Gazette, May 9
docs.body:
To the Editor:

I read with great interest your May 4 article about the Calloway Mill project. As someone who grew up near Fenner Street, I am delighted that the building will finally be put to good use.

However, I am concerned about one aspect of the plan. Many residents of the surrounding neighborhood are elderly and rely on their cars. The bus serving Fenner Street runs only once an hour on weekends, which is exactly when events in the new hall are likely to be held. Without parking, I fear that many of the people the project is meant to serve will be unable to attend.

I urge the council to reconsider this part of the design before construction begins.

Gary Pemberton

docs.head: Riverton Gazette — May 16
docs.body:
Dear Mr. Pemberton,

Thank you for your thoughtful letter regarding parking at the Calloway Mill site. I would like to assure you and other readers that the city has taken this issue into account.

Although the renovated building itself will not include parking, the city has reached an agreement with Harbin Hardware, located directly across Fenner Street, to make its 40-space lot available to the public after 6:00 P.M. on weekdays and all day on Sundays, when the store is closed. In addition, the transit authority has agreed to run buses on the Fenner Street route every 20 minutes on weekends once the facility opens.

Sincerely,
Sunil Mehta
Director, Riverton Department of Planning

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
o: The history of a textile company
The opening of a new bus station
The approval of a plan to reuse a building
qs.ex: 文章開頭即說市議會「voted 6–1 ... to approve a $4.2 million plan to renovate the former Calloway textile mill」。(A) 文中只提及工廠舊址，並未介紹紡織公司的歷史。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned as a planned feature of the renovated mill?
qs.ex: 文章列出「a branch library, a small-business incubator, and a 120-seat event hall」以及「a rooftop garden」，未提到咖啡廳。

qs.q: According to the letter and the reply, how will weekend bus service on the Fenner Street route change once the facility opens?
o: It will run twice as often.
It will be extended into the evening.
It will run three times as often.
It will be replaced by a shuttle.
qs.ex: 讀者投書說週末公車「runs only once an hour」，回信說將改為「every 20 minutes」，一小時三班，班次變為三倍。(A) 兩倍應為每 30 分鐘一班。

qs.q: Approximately when will the change in bus service take effect?
o: About a year and a half after construction starts
Once Harbin Hardware expands its parking lot

It will sponsor events at the new hall.
It is not open on Sundays.
It owns the former mill building.
qs.ex: 回信說停車場週日全天開放，因為「when the store is closed」，即該店週日不營業。(D) 文中只說它位於工廠對面「directly across Fenner Street」，並未說它擁有該建築。

qs.q: What aspect of the LV-3 Pro would Ms. Okoro most likely want to see improved?
qs.ex: 她寫道「My only complaint is the weight」，帶著它走一天後肩膀痠痛。(C) 錯，她說電池「easily lasted through a three-hour session」，是滿意的。

qs.q: In the press release, the word "follow" in paragraph 2, line 2, is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: 「The LV-3 Pro ... will follow on March 15」指 Pro 款將在 LV-3 之後於 3 月 15 日推出，follow 在此為「接著到來」。(C) obey 是「遵守（規則）」的意思，不符語境。

p7.title: Elevator work and a furniture delivery

docs.head: Harrow Tower Management Office — Notice to All Tenants
docs.body:
Beginning Monday, July 7, the three passenger elevators in Harrow Tower will be modernized one at a time. The work will be carried out in the following phases: Elevator A, July 7–25; Elevator B, July 28–August 15; and Elevator C, August 18–September 5. Two elevators will remain in operation throughout, but tenants should expect longer waits, particularly between 8:00 and 9:30 A.M.

During this period, the freight elevator may be reserved for moves and deliveries only from 6:00 to 9:00 A.M. or after 6:00 P.M. Reservations must be submitted at least 48 hours in advance using the form available at the management office in Suite 110.

We appreciate your patience as we work to make the building safer and more energy efficient.

docs.head: Harrow Tower — Freight Elevator Reservation Form
docs.body:
Tenant: Delmont Legal | Suite: 1720
Contact name: Priya Raman | Phone: (312) 555-0148
Date requested: Wednesday, August 20
Time requested: 10:00 A.M.–12:00 P.M.
Purpose: Delivery of new office furniture (Castellan Office Interiors)

Thank you for submitting your reservation form. Unfortunately, I am unable to approve the time you requested. However, I contacted Castellan Office Interiors this morning, and they have agreed to send their crew earlier that day. qs.q: What is the main purpose of the notice?
o: To announce the opening of a management office
To inform tenants about upcoming elevator work
To request feedback on energy use
qs.ex: 公告開頭說「the three passenger elevators in Harrow Tower will be modernized one at a time」並列出各階段日期。(D) 節能只是工程目的「more energy efficient」，並未請住戶提供意見。

qs.q: Which passenger elevator is most likely closest to Delmont Legal's office?
qs.ex: e-mail 說離她辦公室最近的客梯在送貨當天停用，表單上的日期是「Wednesday, August 20」，公告顯示該日落在「Elevator C, August 18–September 5」的施工期間。(C) Elevator B 的工程在 8 月 15 日已結束。

qs.q: Why was Ms. Raman's original request most likely not approved?
o: It was submitted less than 48 hours in advance.
The freight elevator was being modernized.
Another tenant had already reserved that time.
The time requested was outside the permitted hours.
qs.ex: 表單申請時段為「10:00 A.M.–12:00 P.M.」，但公告規定貨梯只能在「from 6:00 to 9:00 A.M. or after 6:00 P.M.」預約。(A) 錯，表單 8 月 14 日送出、使用日為 8 月 20 日，早已超過 48 小時。

qs.q: According to the e-mail, what has Castellan Office Interiors agreed to do?
o: Postpone the delivery by one day
qs.ex: e-mail 說廠商「have agreed to send their crew earlier that day」，即提早開工。(A) 錯，貨梯預約仍在「on the date you requested」，日期沒有延後。

qs.q: What information is NOT included on the form?
o: The name of a delivery company
The date the form was submitted
The number of items to be delivered
qs.ex: 表單上有「Phone: (312) 555-0148」(A)、「Castellan Office Interiors」(B)、「Date submitted: Thursday, August 14」(C)，但沒有寫要運送的家具件數。

docs.head: Saffron & Slate — Private Dining
docs.body:
Host your next business dinner, product launch, or retirement celebration at Saffron & Slate, located in the heart of Seattle's waterfront district. Our private Garden Room seats up to 40 guests, while our Terrace accommodates up to 70 and is open from May through September.

Package | Includes | Price per guest
Essential | Three-course set menu, coffee and tea | $48
Signature | Four-course menu, house wine served with dinner | $72
Premier | Five-course tasting menu, wine pairing, custom-printed menus | $95

Groups of 30 or more receive complimentary use of our projector, screen, and microphone. A deposit of 20 percent of the estimated total is required to confirm any booking. To inquire, e-mail events@saffronandslate.com.

docs.head:
To: events@saffronandslate.com
From: Diego Alvarez <dalvarez@northwindanalytics.com>
Date: September 12
Subject: Private dinner inquiry
docs.body:
Hello,

Northwind Analytics is planning its annual client appreciation dinner for Thursday, October 16, and we are considering Saffron & Slate as the venue. We expect 36 guests.

We would like wine to be served with the meal, but a tasting menu would be more elaborate than our guests need. During dessert, our CEO will present a short video highlighting the year's achievements, so we will need a way to show it. Several colleagues have praised the views from your Terrace, so we would prefer to hold the event there if possible.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Diego Alvarez
Client Relations Manager

docs.head:
To: Diego Alvarez <dalvarez@northwindanalytics.com>
From: Margot Delacroix <events@saffronandslate.com>
Date: September 13
Subject: RE: Private dinner inquiry
docs.body:
Dear Mr. Alvarez,

Thank you for considering Saffron & Slate. Unfortunately, the space you mentioned will not be available on the date of your event. However, our Garden Room is free that evening and will comfortably seat your group.

Based on the preferences you described, I have tentatively reserved the room for you under the package that best matches your needs. Since your group meets our minimum size, the equipment you require will be provided at no charge. To confirm the booking, please submit your deposit by October 1.

Kind regards,
Margot Delacroix
Events Coordinator

qs.q: Why did Mr. Alvarez write the e-mail?
o: To complain about a previous event
To ask about holding an event at a restaurant
To invite clients to a dinner
qs.ex: 他說公司正在籌辦晚宴，「we are considering Saffron & Slate as the venue」，並說明人數與需求，是詢問場地。(A) 錯，訂位是在對方回信中才暫時保留，他本人並未確認訂位。

qs.q: Why is the Terrace unavailable for Northwind Analytics' event?
o: It is not open in October.
qs.ex: 回信說他提到的場地「will not be available on the date of your event」(10 月 16 日)，廣告說露台「is open from May through September」，所以 10 月不開放。(B) 錯，露台可容納「up to 70」人。

qs.q: How much will Mr. Alvarez most likely need to pay as a deposit?
qs.ex: Alvarez 要附葡萄酒但不要品嚐套餐、人數 36 人；廣告中符合的是 Signature 方案「$72」，回信說已依其偏好選擇方案，訂金為「20 percent of the estimated total」：36 × $72 × 20% = $518.40。(C) $684 是 Premier 方案的訂金，(D) 是總額而非訂金。

qs.q: In the e-mail from Ms. Delacroix, the word "tentatively" in paragraph 2, line 1, is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: 「I have tentatively reserved the room」後接「To confirm the booking, please submit your deposit」，可知是付訂金前的暫時保留，tentatively 在此等於 provisionally。(D) hesitantly 是 tentatively 「猶豫地」的另一義，不符此處語境。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned in the advertisement?
o: The capacity of the Garden Room
qs.ex: 廣告提到地點「Seattle's waterfront district」(B)、詢問方式「e-mail events@saffronandslate.com」(C)、Garden Room「seats up to 40 guests」(D)，未提及停車。
